jobs.title: Stroke Program Coordinator
jobs.description:

Learn more about the benefits offered for this job.

As a Stroke Program Coordinator, your voice to influence patient care is valued and empowered at every turn –whether through open, collaborative relationships with your direct manager or more formal opportunities through hospital councils and national nursing initiatives. You'll help shape decisions that elevate both patient outcomes and the future of nursing.

##### **Job Summary and Qualifications**

* Under general supervision, and according to general policies and procedures, as the Stroke Program Coordinator you will develop and implement the Good Samaritan Hospital Stroke Program
* You will assess and analyze outcome measures for continued JCAHO Stroke Center certification, identify educational needs and provide comprehensive education pertaining to stroke intervention, prevention and rehabilitation for inpatients and community
* You will collaborate with nursing management and the Education Department to develop and implement staff education related to stroke issues and make regular rounds on stroke patients to evaluate appropriateness of treatment plan and nursing intervention

###### **What qualifications you will need:**

* Graduate of an accredited School of Nursing required
* Masters Degree Preferred
* Current California Registered Nurse license required
* Current California Board of Registered Nursing Practitioner preferred
* Basic Cardiac Life Support required
* ACLS required
* NIH Stroke Certification required
* 2 Years in acute medical/surgical/ neurological nursing preferred
* Computer literate with in-depth knowledge, experience to operate word processing, data bases, graphics, and spreadsheets in order to generate reports. Ability to learn and operate Krono’s, Meditech, Excel, Word and a patient care management systems. Ability to concentrate, with attention to detail in order to resolve patient care problems and identify patient needs. Ability to show understanding, patience, and tact when dealing with physicians, staff, and the public

* **Education support** through tuition assistance, student loan assistance, certification support, dependent scholarships and a partnership with Galen College of Nursing

jobs.title: Program Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Covenant House California (CHC) is a nonprofit organization that provides sanctuary and support for youth overcoming homelessness, ages 18-24. CHC believes that no young person deserves to be homeless; that every young person in California deserves housing, food, clothing, education, and most importantly, to be loved. CHC provides a full continuum of services to meet the physical, emotional, educational, vocational, and spiritual well-being of young people.

CHC’s doors are open to youth and staff regardless of their race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We believe that youth and team members deserve to be in an environment that is inclusive and affirming; where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and valued and appreciated for who they are. Maintaining a diverse community of youth and staff is key to our ability to achieve our mission most effectively. We are also committed to being a leader in advancing anti-racism, and to promoting opportunities for the free expression of the lived experiences of our youth and staff.

We are looking for people who, like us, believe that every young person deserves a place to belong. We think it takes all kinds of people to create diverse solutions to end youth homelessness and we are on a committed journey to build an inclusive and equitable work culture that brings out the best in everyone.

Covenant House California offers an excellent benefits package, (most benefits effective date of hire), including medical, vision, dental, an EAP program, 403b retirement account, and a generous vacation package.

**Position Summary**

The Program Project Coordinator provides high-level administrative and programmatic support directly to the Chief Program Officer (CPO), helping manage the CPO’s calendar, communications, and day-to-day priorities so the CPO can focus on leading the Program Division effectively. This role will also support the Norcal and Socal SVP’s with special projects, policy/procedures and any duties as assigned to help strengthen program operations and consistency across the state.

This role blends traditional administrative program responsibilities – calendar management, meeting logistics, audit preparations, meeting note compilation and travel coordination – with ownership of special program related project assignments given directly by the CPO. The right person is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable anticipating CPO and SVP’s needs before being asked. They work behind the scenes to keep information flowing, fill various gaps needing administrative support, keep deadlines on track, and the CPO prepared for every meeting – including supporting the tracking of trainings, professional development logistics, and other administrative systems that keep the Program Division organized and unified.

The ideal candidate brings strong administrative and project coordination experience, sound judgment, a passion for serving young people experiencing homelessness and the discretion needed to support a busy executive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

**What Success Looks Like**

* In the first 90 days, the Program Project Coordinator will:
* Complete onboarding, including learning CHC’s program structure and meeting the Program Leadership team
* Take over calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination for the CPO
* Establish organized tracking systems for the CPO and SVP’s special projects, trainings, and meeting follow-ups
* Build a clear working rhythm and communication style with the CPO

**By the end of year one, the Program Project Coordinator will have:**

* Become the CPO’s trusted, go-to resource for scheduling, logistics, and administrative coordination
* Successfully managed several special program related project assignments from start to finish
* Built reliable systems for tracking trainings, onboarding logistics, and program documentation
* Earned the CPO’s confidence as someone who keeps things organized and follows through

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Executive & Calendar Support**

* Manage the CPO’s scheduling, calendar coordination, travel planning, and related logistics, support SVP’s administrative needs as well.
* Coordinate logistics for meetings the CPO leads or attends, including agendas, preparation, action items and follow-ups
* Draft power point presentations, briefing documents, and talking points as directed by the CPO
* Organize and maintain the CPO’s SharePoint folders and internal filing systems

**Special Projects:**

* Own and run special project assignments that are program focused given directly by the CPO, from planning through completion
* Coordinate logistics for the CPO’s tours, speaking engagements, and site visits, including pre-event preparation and follow-up
* Track action items and deadlines on the CPO’s behalf to keep cross-department work moving forward
* Assist the CPO with grant and funder reporting by gathering information and compiling draft materials in collaboration with the Development team

**Training & Program Documentation Support:**

* Maintain tracking tools and attendance systems that support the professional development and training function, at the CPO’s direction and in partnership with the Senior Director of Program Training & Professional Development
* Support onboarding logistics for new program leaders, including scheduling, materials, and checklists
* Help maintain and distribute policy and procedure updates, including notes and follow-ups from relevant Covenant House International (CHI) calls(SCPO Calls, Presidium checklist, Quarterly Data review calls)
* Maintain internal tracking and reporting tools the CPO uses to keep the division organized

**Meeting & Communications Support:**

* Prepare meeting materials, one-pagers, and presentation decks as directed by the CPO
* Take notes and minutes at meetings the CPO attends and distribute follow-up items
* Serve as a point of contact for internal and external inquiri

jobs.description:
Position Information

**Job Title**

Program Coordinator - CalWORKs

  

**Position Type**

Classified

  

**Position Code**

3CCW02

  

**FTE**

1

  

**Pay Rate (or Annual Salary)**

$6,665.92 - $7,006.42/month

  

**Job Location**

Las Positas College, 3000 Campus Hill Dr., Livermore, CA 94551

  

**Department**

Special Programs

  

**Job Summary**

**Las Positas College**  
Las Positas College provides an inclusive, learning-centered, equity-focused environment that offers educational opportunities and support for completion of students’ transfer, degree, and career-technical goals while promoting lifelong learning. At Las Positas College we know that equity will be achieved by changing the impacts of structural racism, ableism, homophobia, and systematic poverty on student success and access to higher education, achieved through continuous evaluation and improvement of all services. We believe in a high-quality education focused on learning and an inclusive, culturally-relevant environment that meets the diverse needs of all our students and staff.
  
  
Equity is parity in student educational outcomes; it places belonging for students of color and disproportionately impacted students at center focus. Our prized and emerging equity efforts include Puente, Umoja, ConnectUp, Brother 2 Brother, Sister 2 Sister, Black Student Union, Presidential Task Force on Systemic and Institutionalized Racism, the Presidential Speaker Series, Black Education Association, UndocuAlly Taskforce, curriculum reviews and a linguistic justice curriculum.  
  
Located in Livermore, Las Positas College is becoming an institution that reflects the diversity in California. We are a learning-centered institution focused on excellence and student success, and are fully committed to supporting all Tri-Valley residents in their quest for education and advancement.  
  
**Joining Our College Community**  
We seek equity-minded applicants who demonstrate they understand the benefits diversity brings to an educational community. We look for applicants who:Value and intentionally promote diversity and consciousness of differenceDemonstrate cultural humility and an ongoing desire to improve cultural competenceAre dedicated to addressing issues of social justiceAccept their shared role and responsibility in addressing opportunity and achievement gaps experienced by studentsHave experience and success in closing student equity gaps and engaging in equitable practices, or are knowledgeable and enthusiastic about implementing practices that achieve these goalsActively seek to identify, disrupt, and remove institutional and/or systemic barriers that adversely impact historically marginalized communitiesEmpower the underrepresented and underservedFoster students’ potential to become global citizens and socially responsible leadersBelieve that all people have the right to an education and work environment free from fear, harassment, or discrimination.  
  
The Chabot-Las Positas Community College District is seeking to fill a Program Coordinator – CalWORKs position for Las Positas College in Livermore, California.  
  
**SUMMARY****DESCRIPTION**  
Under direction, oversee and coordinate the day-to-day operations of the CalWORKs program including performing a variety of para-professional, technical, administrative, and complex office support work related to enhancing services for students including CalWORKs, foster youth, and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless; assume responsibility for program coordination, implementation, outreach, monitoring, tracking, and reporting; establish and monitor program budgets; coordinate with administration, faculty, staff, and community members to enlist support, cooperation, and participation in appropriate activities related to assigned program(s); and serves as a resource and liaison for students including CalWORKs, foster youth, and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
This is a grant/categorically funded position. Continuation of this position is contingent upon available funding on a year to year basis.

  

**Representative Duties**

The following duties are typical for this classification. Incumbents may not perform all of the listed duties and/or may be required to perform additional or different duties from those set forth below to address business needs and changing business practices.  
  
1. Coordinate the daily services and activities of the CalWORKs program and activities related to foster youth and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
2. Develop the CalWORKs program plan and budget; coordinate budget planning activities and monitor expenditures; prepare monthly budget reports and year-end accountability report; serve as a liaison for both internal and external departments and agencies.  
  
3. Develop, recommend, and implement program plans and objectives; coordinate delivery of service to program participants; ensure participation guidelines are followed.  
  
4. Ensure program expenditures are within allocated budgets and program activities comply with program standards, the CalWORKs Program Plan, and compliance requirements; research potential programs/grants for foster youth and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
5. Conduct intake and orientation to incoming students; determine students’ eligibility for the program; conduct needs assessments; refer students to appropriate resources.  
  
6. Coordinate child care component of program including eligibility and expenditure of funds.  
  
7. Maintain records of student program completion and job attainment.  
  
8. Coordinate with staff in designing and implementing recruitment strategies to support program goals and objectives and to strengthen collaboration with other programs.  
  
9. Provide orientation and training to new employees when assigned; assign, schedule, train, and provide work direction to office staff

jobs.title: Gender Affirming Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Femmes Against Violence Program**  
**Program Coordinator**

***Full-time, Union Position***

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Description:** Femmes Against Violence (FAV) is an 18-week, cohort-based program that promotes healing, agency, leadership, and self-determination among youth ages 14–21, including femme-identified and gender-expansive youth of color. Offered twice annually, FAV engages youth three days per week through culturally affirming, gender-responsive, youth-centered programming.

The program integrates intersectional, liberatory frameworks grounded in Black feminist theory, Indigenous teachings, ancestral knowledge, collective care, and community accountability through interactive workshops, experiential activities, community outings, guest speakers, and youth-led action projects. Programming explores identity, culture, relationships, gender-based violence prevention, systems of power and oppression, and pathways toward personal and collective well-being. Youth develop critical consciousness, leadership, advocacy, communication, and self-determination skills while engaging in opportunities to apply their learning through creative and experiential activities.

FAV also provides a wraparound support model that connects youth to mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources. FAV creates a supportive space where youth can build belonging, strengthen their voices and leadership capacity, develop healthy coping and relationship skills, and envision and pursue futures grounded in care, justice, and self-determination.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee delivery of the FAV program in accordance with the approved work plan and scope of services, including outreach and recruitment, orientation and enrollment, life skills, peer education, leadership development, culturally and gender-affirming activities and events, youth-led projects, and related services.
* Develop, implement, and adapt program curriculum, workshops, training materials, and experiential activities that support FAV program goals and youth outcomes.
* Facilitate culturally and gender-affirming trainings, workshops, group activities, presentations, and community outings for FAV participants.
* Support youth in developing and implementing creative projects, presentations, educational materials, and other activities that promote awareness, leadership, advocacy, and positive community engagement.
* Work collaboratively with other Horizons programs to ensure a cohesive program model and coordinated services for participating youth.
* Advocate for FAV participants and support access to appropriate services, resources, and opportunities.
* Communicate regularly with participants regarding program participation, needs, progress, and available resources.
* Cultivate and maintain working relationships with schools, community-based organizations, government agencies, SFUSD Wellness Centers, Community Health Outreach Workers, and other appropriate partners to recruit and enroll youth and maintain a strong referral network.
* Network and participate in community committees, meetings, and collaborative efforts that promote FAV, strengthen partnerships, and expand resources and opportunities for participants.
* Coordinate with participants and staff to implement evaluation and feedback tools that measure program effectiveness, participant satisfaction, and progress toward program outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and timely program records, participant documentation, data, reports, and budgets, including required entries into the agency's CMS and GMS system.
* Facilitate connections to wraparound and support services, including mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources.
* Participate in weekly team meetings, individual supervision, and other internal meetings that support effective program delivery and professional development.
* Complete required agency and funder trainings and maintain knowledge of applicable program standards, policies, and funding requirements.
* Participate in at least one agency-wide committee, project, or working group annually.
* Attend agency and funder meetings, quarterly All Grantee meetings, and other meetings that support programmatic integration within the agency and broader community.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by the Program Director.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree in psychology, women’s or ethnic studies and/or a closely related field, and/or comparable experience to meet this requirement (2+ years).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience working with self-identified young women of color who have been system-impacted.
* Direct knowledge regarding youth development and empowerment principles, intervention strategies, best practices in serving system-impacted youth, harm reduction, etc.
* Experience coordinating after-school, leadership or other youth programming.
* Extensive knowledge of gender-based violence intervention strategies, sexual assault, domestic violence a must.
* Strong communication (verbal and written) and organizational sk

jobs.title: Overnight Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overnight Care Coordinator Position Description:**

The overnight care coordinator provides supervision and support to clients in the residential treatment facility during the overnight shift.

**Overnight Care Coordinator Primary Responsibilities:**

* Monitor the residential milieu overnight by conducting rounds in timeframes prescribed by agency policy and procedure
* Ensure the safety and security of clients and the facility
* Assist clients with their needs and refer them to their counselor for clinical support
* Maintain continuity among work teams by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities and ongoing client needs in chart and shift log notes
* Perform urinalysis testing as needed
* Educate and remind clients of the rules, policies and procedures of the facility.
* Establish appropriate boundaries amongst clients and staff, ensuring professional and courteous interactions and fostering opportunities to implement newly developed life skills
* Assist with medication monitoring, counting, and compliance as needed
* Set up, serve, and monitor client breakfast
* Wash linens and perform light household tasks
* Ensure cleanliness of office and client treatment areas
* Perform additional duties as assigned by the program director

**Overnight Care Coordinator Qualifications:**

* One-year practical experience in drug/alcohol or mental health field preferred (employment, internship or volunteer work); preferred RADT, working towards certification in drug and alcohol counseling
* Basic understanding of treatment and rehabilitation techniques
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively within a team as well as alone
* Ability to work effectively with people differing in value systems, ethnicity, cultural backgrounds, language capabilities and disabilities
* Exercise good judgment and respond calmly in emergency situations
* Ability to work effectively; independently and within a group, with limited supervision
* Must maintain the highest standards of professional ethics and behavior as described in the Pathway Society handbook.
* Must be able to physically respond to clients’ needs, climb stairs and walk through the facility throughout the shift
* Must pass a criminal records clearance as required the County of Santa Clara Department of Alcohol and Drugs regulations.
* Receive training and pass certification testing in the areas of HIPAA, 42 CFR and CPR/First Aid once county clearance is received.

**Overnight Care Coordinator Physical Requirements**

* Climbing; ascending or descending stairs, ramps, using feet and legs and/or hands and arms.
* Kneeling; bending legs at knee to come to a rest on knee or knees.
* Crouching; bending the body downward and forward by bending leg and spine.
* Reaching; extending hand (s) and arms above head in any direction.
* Hearing; perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction, ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.
* Lifting; able to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects up to 20 pounds.
* Visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures and viewing a computer terminal.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, activities and scheduled shift may change at any time, with or without notice.

Practice Coordinators are responsible for scheduling new and follow-up patient appointments and processing incoming and internal referrals.

* Successfully passes fingerprinting protocol and is approved to be a cash collector if applicable.
* Strong computer skills, including basic keyboarding skills, and experience with at least two Office-type software programs (i.e., Outlook, Word and Excel). Proven ability to navigate through multiple patient records systems. Able to sit at a computer terminal with telephone headphones for extended period of time.
* Ability to analyze situations, prioritizes, and develops solutions and makes recommendations.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision
* Ability to use good judgment and work independently, at times under the pressure of deadlines

* Ability to deal sensitively and effectively with patients.
* Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
* Strong writing skills to include the ability to compose, edit, and proof a wide variety of documents.

This includes the following areas if applicable: Referrals (Incoming referral entry) and handling all referral WQs Schedule surgeries, Work applicable work queues, Enter/edit outside test results, Messaging (CRM) if applicable, 2nd calls in CRM if applicable, Telephone encounters, My open encounter, Staff message, New message, Route Patient advice request to providers (My Chart), Patient Schedule (My Chart), Letters, Pools, Patient look up, Check in process, Check out process, Comment field, Quick note, Scanning

The parking is free at our Brisbane and Emeryville locations; however, most San Francisco locations do not have free parking

jobs.title: HR Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Whether you're a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

**Why Rosendin?**
-----------------

**Committed. Innovative. Engaged.**
-----------------------------------

If you're looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. Since our founding over 100+ years ago, Rosendin has been driven to positively impact the communities where we live and work. We are an organization built on integrity and we have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. As one of the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractors in the United States, you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success. When our people succeed and fuel our success, we reward them. We'd love to have you as a shareholder!

**YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:**
--------------------------

The HR Operations Specialist executes the work that requires system expertise, compliance knowledge, and independent judgment. You are the person the Admins escalate to, and the person who ensures transactions are processed accurately before they touch payroll, legal, or the employee record. This role requires a strong understanding of HR processes, a high degree of accuracy, and the ability to manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
-------------------

**Payroll, Benefits & Leave Processing**

* Process complex payroll transactions including garnishments, final checks, officer medical, tuition reimbursement, and payroll corrections; partner with Payroll on escalated issues
* Manage benefits life event processing, troubleshooting, and vendor portal administration; serve as the escalation point for benefits questions the Admin team cannot resolve
* Own leave case management including LOA documentation, FMLA eligibility tracking, workers compensation, and coordination with HRBPs and payroll

**Workday Transactions & Data Integrity**

* Process complex Workday transactions including hires, terminations, transfers, compensation changes, promotions, job changes, and position management
* Review and audit transactions for accuracy; identify and correct errors before they create downstream impact in payroll or reporting
* Manage the Workday inbox and ServiceNow ticket queue for complex cases requiring system access or compliance judgment

**Compliance, Legal & ER Support**

* Support ER documentation, investigation coordination, and accommodation request processing in partnership with the HR Ops Lead, HRBPs, and Legal
* Manage H1-B immigration case coordination and attorney communication; maintain compliance with all filing deadlines
* Compile and manage personnel records for legal requests, ensuring appropriate handling and custodian sign-off

**Vendor, Contingent Worker & Total Rewards Administration**

* Process vendor invoices, manage the contingent worker tracker, and support CW onboarding and offboarding in Workday
* Administer total rewards programs including referral bonuses, service awards, car allowance, and ESOP processing
* Conduct recurring compliance and data audits across payroll, I-9s, onboarding, leave, and Workday data quality

**Learning & Development Support**

* Deliver HR-related training, manage training assignments in Workday, and track and report training compliance
* Support ROOT program facilitation and L&D event coordination
* The duties described are representative of this role; additional responsibilities will be assigned based on team needs

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:**
--------------------------------------

* 2-4 years of experience in an HR operations, HRIS, or HR coordinator role
* Strong Workday HCM experience - transaction processing, data entry, and reporting
* Demonstrated knowledge of leave administration, payroll processes, and benefits operations
* Working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, COBRA, and applicable state leave laws
* Strong attention to detail; you understand that errors in this role have real downstream consequences
* Ability to manage multiple active cases and transactions simultaneously with a high degree of accuracy
* High professional discretion when handling sensitive employee, legal, and compliance matters
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred; combination of education and experience accepted

**WHAT YOU BRING TO US:**
-------------------------

* 1-2 years of experience in HR support, administrative coordination, or a related role
* Can be a combination of education, training, and relevant experience

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**
-----------------------

* General work environment - sitting for long periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning

jobs.description:
Description:

**Position Summary**

The Operations Program Manager (OPM) is responsible for the successful execution of assigned customer programs and manufacturing orders from purchase order acceptance through production, final inspection, shipment, and delivery.

As A1J Technologies transitions from a traditional precision machining job shop into a scalable Tier 1 supplier supporting commercial aerospace and defense customers, this position plays a critical role in strengthening program accountability, cross-functional coordination, customer communication, and on-time delivery performance.

The Operations Program Manager serves as the primary internal coordinator for assigned customer programs, ensuring that Engineering, CNC Programming, Master Scheduling, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Shipping activities are aligned with contractual requirements, approved delivery commitments, and operational priorities.

This position is responsible for maintaining accurate program status, identifying and escalating execution risks, coordinating recovery plans, monitoring program milestones, and ensuring customer commitments are supported by realistic manufacturing schedules and available resources.

The successful candidate must demonstrate strong manufacturing knowledge, program execution discipline, customer communication skills, and the ability to drive accountability across multiple departments without direct functional authority.

**Primary Responsibilities**

### **Customer Program Ownership & Execution**

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned customer programs and manufacturing orders.
* Maintain end-to-end visibility of assigned jobs from order acceptance through manufacturing, inspection, shipment, and delivery.
* Review customer purchase orders, contractual delivery commitments, program requirements, and critical milestones in coordination with CSR, Sales, Engineering, and Quality.
* Establish program execution plans identifying key deliverables, manufacturing milestones, schedule dependencies, and operational risks.
* Ensure assigned programs are executed in accordance with customer requirements, approved schedules, and applicable quality standards.
* Monitor overall program progress and coordinate cross-functional actions necessary to achieve customer delivery commitments.
* Identify potential delays, resource constraints, and execution issues before they affect customer deliveries.
* Maintain ownership of program-level action items, risk registers, recovery plans, and customer commitments.
* Escalate unresolved issues to Operations leadership with recommended corrective actions.

**2. Program Planning & Manufacturing Readiness**

* Coordinate with Engineering, Process Engineering, CNC Programming, Supply Chain, Quality, and Master Scheduling to ensure jobs are ready for manufacturing.
* Monitor engineering reviews, routing development, traveler preparation, CNC programming, material procurement, tooling availability, and inspection planning.
* Establish and track preproduction milestones to support planned manufacturing start dates.
* Identify incomplete engineering packages, material shortages, programming delays, or unresolved technical requirements.
* Coordinate timely resolution of manufacturing readiness issues with responsible department managers.
* Participate in manufacturing readiness reviews for new, complex, high-priority, or customer-critical programs.
* Ensure customer-driven changes are communicated to affected departments and incorporated into approved program plans.
* Support first-article and new product introduction activities by tracking technical, manufacturing, and quality readiness.

**3. Production Schedule Coordination & Delivery Performance**

* Partner with the Master Scheduler to review production schedules, planned operation completion dates, and customer delivery commitments.
* Monitor assigned jobs against approved manufacturing schedules and identify schedule deviations.
* Coordinate with the Production Manager to understand manufacturing priorities, capacity constraints, and production recovery requirements.
* Maintain visibility of manufacturing progress across machining, outside processing, inspection, and shipping operations.
* Identify jobs at risk of missing planned milestones or customer delivery dates.
* Coordinate cross-functional recovery actions to address delays and restore program execution.
* Evaluate the delivery impact of machine downtime, material shortages, engineering delays, quality issues, and outside processing constraints.
* Support the development of realistic delivery projections based on verified manufacturing status and approved scheduling assumptions.
* Ensure schedule risks and changes are communicated promptly to appropriate stakeholders.
* Do not independently change the master production schedule or direct machine-level priorities outside established Operations approval processes.

**4. Customer Communication & Program Reporting**

* Provide accurate, timely, and professional status updates to customers and internal stakeholders within assigned communication authority.
* Prepare customer program trackers, milestone schedules, delivery recovery plans, and operational progress reports.
* Coordinate with CSR and Sales to ensure customer communications reflect verified manufacturing status and approved commitments.
* Lead or participate in customer program reviews, production status meetings, and delivery recovery discussions.
* Communicate program risks, corrective actions, and anticipated delivery impacts clearly and proactively.
* Maintain documented customer commitments, action items, and follow-up responsibilities.
* Support customer visits, operational reviews, and program execution discussions.
* Ensure delivery commitments and recovery dates are approved by the appropriate Operations and commercial authorities before being communicated externally.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

  

**About the role**

The **Operations Manager** will serve as the end-to-end owner of market operations, responsible for leading a high-performing team, delivering on key performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement. This role is ideal for a high-agency operator who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves to solve problems from first principles.

You will lead day-to-day execution while identifying opportunities to scale processes, improve efficiency, and enhance the driver and passenger experience. Success in this role requires a strong drive for action, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to develop talent while holding teams accountable to results. This is a critical leadership role with direct impact on Atoms's growth and operational excellence.

  

**What you'll do**

* **Own and drive the end-to-end operations of your depot –** you are the leader of your business, responsible for performance and execution exceeding performance metric goals.
* **Own costs, and performance management** across all ops team members, ensuring a lean, high-output team.
* **Own all aspects of fleet operations –** from vehicle health and availability to onboarding ensuring maximum uptime and reducing unnecessary downtime.
* **Lead with data**: Solve real-world problems using first-principles, taking an analytical approach to delivering results.
* **Inspire and develop** high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, and clear accountability; build future leaders by fostering ownership at all levels.
* **Identify and own high-impact projects** that move the needle on efficiency, scalability, and customer experience—then drive them from ideation through execution.
* **Foster a culture of bias for action** and operational excellence, where problems are surfaced early and solved quickly.
* **Continuously challenge the status quo**: Look for opportunities to automate, streamline, or rethink legacy processes to scale faster and better.
* **Develop deep understanding of business needs** – to serve as the connective tissue across departments, ensuring alignment, communication, and accountability from strategy through frontline execution.
* **Relentlessly pursue operational improvement**, leveraging data and feedback loops to refine the market's roadmap and deliver exceptional results.

  

**What we're looking for**

* **Bachelor's degree in Business Admin, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering,** or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience** in operations, logistics, or fleet-based startups where you owned execution, solved problems from first principles, and managed performance in fast-paced environments.
* **3+ years of direct people leadership experience,** including hiring, coaching, and holding teams accountable to outcomes in hourly or shift-based workforces.
* **Proven experience managing fleet operations**, with a focus on maximizing vehicle uptime, utilization, and operational efficiency.
* **Strong analytical skill set**, with the ability to use data to identify bottlenecks, prioritize high-impact initiatives, and drive continuous improvement
* **Exceptional communicator**, capable of aligning field teams and HQ stakeholders through clear, concise written and verbal updates
* **Builder mindset** with product orientation, eager to create systems, improve workflows, and collaborate with tech teams to influence tools and process design
* **Self-directed operator with a high sense of ownership**, who thrives in ambiguity and moves quickly from insight to action

  

**Why join us**

At Atoms, you'll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what's known and building what doesn't yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it's grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

  

**What else you need to know**

This role is based in our San Franciscooffice. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is **$115,000 - $134,000 per year.**

We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. * Prepare accurate project estimates, quotes, and proposals based on customer requirements, measurements, materials, and labor costs.
* Review project plans, drawings, specifications, and measurements to determine project scope and pricing.
* Coordinate and oversee residential and commercial stone projects from initial consultation through completion.
* Monitor project progress, timelines, budgets, and material requirements.
* Communicate with customers, contractors, designers, suppliers, and installation teams throughout each project.
* Conduct site visits and take measurements as needed.
* Identify and address project-related issues to ensure timely completion.
* Maintain accurate project records, estimates, contracts, and documentation.

**Scheduling & Coordination**

* Schedule customer consultations, site visits, measurements, deliveries, and installations.
* Coordinate daily and weekly schedules with installation crews, contractors, and suppliers.
* Monitor project timelines and make scheduling adjustments as needed.
* Follow up with customers regarding project updates, appointments, and completion dates.
* Ensure materials, equipment, and personnel are properly coordinated for scheduled projects.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining clear communication with all parties involved.

**Marketing & Business Development**

* Assist with developing and implementing marketing strategies to attract new customers and generate business opportunities.
* Build and maintain relationships with homeowners, contractors, designers, builders, and other potential clients.
* Follow up on sales leads, customer inquiries, and potential projects.
* Promote company products and services to prospective customers.
* Assist with social media, online marketing, and other promotional activities as needed.
* Identify opportunities to expand the customer base and strengthen existing business relationships.
* Support customer satisfaction and encourage repeat business and referrals.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Previous experience in estimating, project management, construction, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in the stone, countertop, fabrication, installation, or construction industry strongly preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, and project specifications.
* Strong understanding of project estimating, measurements, materials, and labor costs.
* Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience coordinating schedules, contractors, vendors, and installation teams.
* Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
* Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office, Excel, email, and estimating or project management software.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Willingness to participate in marketing, sales, and business development activities.
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as needed preferred.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a dependable, motivated, and results-driven individual who can successfully balance estimating, project management, scheduling, and marketing responsibilities.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable interacting with customers, managing project timelines, coordinating with installation teams, and helping develop new business opportunities. Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills are essential for success in this role.

We value individuals who take initiative, demonstrate professionalism, and are committed to delivering quality work and excellent customer service.

Pay: From $1.00 per year

* What was your reason for leaving your previous employment?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Manager, Data Transformation
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

As Program Manager, Data Transformation, you will run the day-to-day program engine that turns Oura's business data into governed, trusted, decision-ready metrics. You will work inside the Data Transformation program, alongside the Staff Program Manager, and own the delivery rhythm for your assigned data domains: intake, prioritization, tracking, ownership, certification, and reporting. Early focus areas include Hardware and Supply Chain, where the need for structure is greatest.A core part of the job is metric certification and intake discipline. You will enforce the three-path model for every request and metric: Directional (fit for use, fast), Governed (executive, board, investor, or external numbers, with a certification path), and Not ours (operational or application work rerouted to the owning business team). You will also drive the work itself, including sprints where they help, so certification and delivery commitments actually land.Hardware and supply chain data, for example, spans manufacturing, quality, logistics, sourcing, planning, and new product introduction. This role connects those teams to Data Engineering and Analytics so that the numbers executives, finance, and auditors rely on (for example warranty rate, click-to-delivery, and yield) have one definition, one owner, and a clear path from directional to governed to certified.This role is ideal for a program manager who is comfortable in ambiguity, can read a data pipeline diagram as easily as a project plan, and likes bringing structure to fast-moving, cross-functional work.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Take business metrics from informally tracked to fully certified, each with a locked definition, a single accountable owner, and documented lineage and controls
* Make sure every key metric in your domains has a clear owner and approver, and keep that ownership current as the business changes
* Triage incoming data requests by their intended use and level of rigor, and route work that belongs to other teams to the right place
* Run a structured intake process with clear priorities, business justification, and reliable response times
* Drive cross-functional programs to completion across Data Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Hardware, and IT, using agile practices where they help
* Keep program plans accurate and visible, with named leads, dates, and status that stakeholders can trust
* Track data issues and metric regressions through to resolution, and support documentation for internal and external audit
* Communicate progress and data health clearly to senior leaders, and drive adoption of standardized metric definitions

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

### **What you'll bring**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in program management, technical program management, or business operations, including time supporting data, analytics, or operations teams
* Experience running cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and competing priorities, without formal authority
* Experience with metric governance or controls work: definitions, ownership, documentation, and formal sign-off
* Comfortable working in Databricks or a similar lakehouse: can navigate the catalog, read a SQL query or model to understand how a metric is computed, and spot-check numbers against source tables
* Working understanding of data pipelines and transformation layers (dbt or equivalent): can follow lineage from source system to reported number and explain where a metric is computed
* Experience with data quality controls: defining validation tests, reading test results, and tracing failures to root cause
* Comfort holding a process line with senior stakeholders, including redirecting requests, while keeping relationships intact
* Hands-on experience with work tracking tools such as Jira, and with running sprints or lightweight agile cadences
* Clear written and verbal communication, including status reporting for senior audiences
  

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience with hardware, manufacturing, quality, logistics, sourcing, or supply planning
* Background in consumer hardware, wearables, medical devices, or another regulated hardware business
* Exposure to financial reporting, SOX-style controls, audit preparation, or IPO readiness
* Experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO company
* Experience working with distributed teams across US and European time zones
* Comfort using modern AI tooling to speed up analysis, documentation, and reporting

### **Benefits**

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive salary
* Lunch benefit
* Wellness benefit
* Flexible working hours
* Collaborative, smart teammates
* An Ōura ring of your own
* Wellness Time Off
  

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

jobs.description:
This position will work one day per week onsite in San Francisco.

The AI Program Manager serves as an organization-wide expert and strategic advisor leading UCSF’s enterprise AI program across clinical care, research, education, and administrative operations. The incumbent partners with Enterprise AI product, technical, and leadership stakeholders to translate institutional priorities and complex business needs into adoption plans, enablement programs, stakeholder engagement strategies, feedback loops, and sustainable operating practices. The role evaluates organizational readiness, workflows, stakeholder needs, and performance data to identify opportunities that improve institutional effectiveness, workforce experience, quality, and mission outcomes.

The incumbent coordinates the adoption, enablement, communications, stakeholder engagement, value tracking, and operational readiness components of a high-impact portfolio of AI initiatives from intake through implementation, adoption, value realization, and transition to operations. The role supports prioritization and resource planning by preparing analysis, maintaining visibility into progress and risks, facilitating multidisciplinary coordination, and escalating complex or politically sensitive issues for leadership decision-making.

The AI Program Manager leads awareness and adoption of approved AI tools by communicating available capabilities, appropriate use cases, limitations, support resources, and product roadmaps. Working with senior leaders and clinical, research, academic, operational, technology, and risk stakeholders, the incumbent advances responsible AI adoption, informs vendor and product decisions, leads organizational change, and represents UCSF in relevant University and industry forums. The role works in close partnership with Enterprise AI product leadership, who retain accountability for product strategy, platform roadmap, prioritization recommendations, and product/vendor decision-making.

It supports enterprise services such as UCSF ChatGPT Enterprise and the Versa API, providing secure access to generative AI and multiple AI models. jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Accessibility
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

### **About the Role**

As the Senior Program Manager, Accessibility at Twitch, you will have a broad impact across all of Twitch and our Community. Reporting into the VP of UX, you will join our Design team where you will own the program design, education and enablement, and the auditing and testing output. We will look to you to execute the vision of how Twitch will be a welcome home for all regardless of abilities. You will partner with product, design, engineering, and legal to solve accessibility problems at scale and provide strategic solutions.

You can work from Twitch’s headquarters in San Francisco, CA; or from one of our hub locations in Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; or New York City, NY - with West Coast (PST) working hours.

### **You Will:**

* **Strategy & SME:** Serve as the subject-matter expert for global digital accessibility across Twitch - advising product and partner teams, and leading process and tooling integration (including AI where appropriate).
* **Operations & Backlog:** Own intake, backlog, and operational management - partnering with engineering, product, and design leaders to prioritize and drive core accessibility issues, with regular communications and reporting.
* **QA & Testing:** Lead QA execution and manage QA specialists and third-party vendors; partner with engineers to build automated accessibility testing into CI/CD pipelines, shifting testing earlier in the development lifecycle.
* **High-impact programs:** Work with engineers, designers, product managers, and researchers to identify and deliver high-impact changes and programs across all products.
* **Partnerships:** Collaborate with accessibility partners (legal, research, policy, communications) on benchmarking, goal-setting, reporting, and execution.
* **Education & Enablement:** Develop an educational program and deploy guidelines and resources for key collaborators.

### **You Have:**

* You have 6+ years experience building similar Accessibility programs, QA and other scalable Accessibility Practices.
* Expertise in accessibility best practices, guidelines, and regulations—specifically WCAG 2.2+ AA and the CVAA; ability to advise the executive team on risk assessment.
* You have experience creating and leading an accessibility program from ground up including creating, documenting, proactive management and driving deliverables.
* Experience working with and consulting product, design, engineering, and legal teams to deliver accessibility audits, code reviews and other advisory services.
* Experience working on consumer product accessibility both on video and communications products and across a variety of devices, such as desktop, smartphone, gaming console, and OTT services.
* Awareness of assistive technologies available to people with disabilities.
* Experience with Figma, Jira and similar relevant product development tools.

### **Bonus Points**

* Understanding of and familiarity with AI tooling and test automations for Accessibility
* Familiarity with Twitch as a user, streamer, or both!

### **Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
* 401(k)
* Maternity & Parental Leave
* Flexible PTO
* Amazon Employee Discount

  

*Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position**

The Senior Project Manager, Multiport leads and organizes a diverse set of activities of the Program Management Office (PMO) group within the New Product Development organization. The PMO group is responsible for leading cross functional teams in new product development and continuation engineering initiatives, and consists of project managers, program managers and project coordinators.

The Senior Project Manager, Multiport orchestrates the activities of their project teams to deliver compelling final product designs within demanding product release schedules. This role will have a focus on complex surgical robotic instrumentation (e.g. stapling, vessel sealing devices), including bringing new innovative technology and design improvements to global markets. The Senior Project Manager, Multiport must be highly organized and detail-oriented, and interact fluidly and effectively with numerous individuals and departments. The Senior Project Manager, PMO will have a close working relationship with the Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Human Factors, Technical Publications, Training, Service, Finance, and Marketing departments, as well as other program and project managers.

**Essential Job Duties**

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead and drive a portfolio of complex, cross-functional product development projects from conception to manufacturing stability, with an initial focus on disposable surgical robotic instrumentation
* Ensure Design Control processes are followed per relevant procedures
* Ensure that complex, high-value Business Unit projects are properly scoped, resourced, and communicated to minimize risk, deliver on-time and on-budget
  + Function as the primary point-of-contact for key leaders and stakeholders across the organization
  + Organize and manage team meetings, design review meetings, and phase gate review meetings
  + Create and maintain project schedules
  + Develop and monitor project budgets
  + Support resource demand planning for project teams, including estimating project work efforts, needs, roles, and responsibilities
  + Lead large, distributed cross-functional teams to execute effectively
  + Plan and track the creation of design history documents for projects by the project teams
* Facilitate best practices sharing and feedback to the PMO organization and seek areas of process improvements

**Strategy & Prioritization**

* Support in defining and aligning project goals with business unit and corporate objectives; organize and prioritize the work of teams to accomplish those objectives
* Work closely with Product Development Franchise leaders to develop plans to meet strategic objectives
* Contribute to product prioritization decisions by providing data and analysis from current and past projects

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Support team members including functional managers across the business to plan and execute the activities required to achieve project goals
* Work closely with Design, Manufacturing, Marketing, Regulatory, and Quality organizations to ensure input and representation in the development process
* Work with Operations and Manufacturing management to determine strategies for product cut-ins and roll-ins
* Coordinate effectively with other project managers who are driving overall product development programs to understand project goals, scope, timelines, and help functional managers negotiate resources and schedules

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Communicate project priorities, key project deliverables, milestones and project risk broadly and effectively— including within the PMO team, to all cross-functional team members, to business unit management, and to shared services management
* Build strong formal and informal communication channels to keep all stakeholders informed of accurate and timely information
* Provide feedback to team members regarding performance and requirements

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Highly passionate about delivering improved surgical solutions to patients, with a proven ability to coordinate and drive cross-functional teams
* Strong project/program management, planning, decision making, negotiating, communication, and change management skills
* Experience and skills developing medical device products through Design Controls with a high level of complexity, including consumables with demonstrated success at product launches as a result of completing product development cycles
* Proven ability to lead, influence and work well at all levels of an organization and in a cross functional team environment
* Experience with leading people within a project team that includes many engineering disciplines, including clinical, mechanical, electrical, and software

jobs.description:
**Implementation Manager - San Francisco**

As a key member of the Product function, the Implementation Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional teams to guide embedded clients (NeoBanks, Marketplaces, Payroll companies) through implementations. This role combines project management excellence, API implementation coordination, and relationship management to ensure our most complex partnerships achieve exceptional outcomes while building repeatable processes for future growth.

In this role, you'll work alongside Product Managers, Partnership Managers, and dedicated specialists from Operations and Compliance to deliver world-class implementation experiences.

**About us**

Sokin is a next-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency.  
Our mission is simple: we’re simplifying global business - so businesses thrive wherever they choose to grow. We deliver services across:

* Global payments and receivables
* Foreign Exchange (FX)
* Treasury management
* Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America, backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide.

Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we’re building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Orchestration**

Cross-functional Team Coordination: Coordinate a bespoke Implementation team made of individuals from Sokin Sales, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations teams, based globally, throughout the implementation lifecycle, ensuring clients’ onboarding and operating experience is fast and easy

**Implementation Planning:** Create and maintain implementation plans with clear deliverables, timelines, owners, and dependencies for both Sokin and client teams, driving accountability and momentum

**Stakeholder Alignment**: Facilitate appropriate meetings and communication channels to ensure all teams remain aligned on priorities, timelines, and evolving client expectations

**Resource Coordination:** Work with department leads to align cross-team resources across multiple concurrent implementations, managing competing priorities and ensuring optimal team usage and efficient implementation pipelines.

**Client impact analysis:** Gather data around expected client impact (volume projections, expected response times etc) and share with product and engineering as contributions to the product prioritisation and planning process

**Risk Management**

**Proactive Risk Identification:** Continuously assess and document implementation risks including technical, commercial, regulatory, and operational threats to successful delivery

**Escalation Management:** Establish clear escalation paths and proactively escalate blockers to appropriate stakeholders before they impact timelines, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining implementation momentum

**Issue Resolution Leadership:** Lead cross-functional issue resolution efforts, bringing together the right expertise and decision-makers to unblock progress and prevent recurring problems

**Implementation Reviews & Handoff**

**Success Criteria Validation:** Collaborate with client teams to define clear, measurable acceptance criteria for the implementation and ensure all requirements are met before go-live

**Go-Live Coordination:** Orchestrate go-live activities across all teams, providing immediate post-launch support and monitoring to ensure smooth transition to production for the client

**Handoff Execution:** Execute structured handoffs to ongoing support teams with documentation, knowledge transfer sessions, and transition planning

**Post-Implementation Review:** Conduct thorough lessons learned sessions with internal teams to capture improvement opportunities and celebrate successes

**Process Improvement**

**Journey Process Documentation:** Create, maintain, and continuously improve detailed process documentation for embedded client implementation journeys

**Process Optimization:** Analyze implementation data, client feedback, and team insights to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process enhancement

**Cross-team Feedback Integration:** Collect, synthesize, and act upon feedback from all internal teams based on implementation experiences and client interactions

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years of implementation or project management experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or fintech environments
* Proven track record managing complex enterprise implementations involving APIs, integrations, or embedded solutions from initiation through completion
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder relationships in matrix organizations with competing priorities
* Stakeholder management experience managing relationships with technical stakeholders, and C-level executives
* Background in payments, financial services, embedded finance, marketplace technologies, or API-driven products preferred

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Veeco**  
You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

  

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers.

  

**OVERVIEW**
============

  

Veeco is transferring existing Advanced Packaging Lithography and Laser Annealing products to contract manufacturing partners in Asia for reliable volume production. This position will report to Vice President, Supply Chain in a full-time role requiring significant international engagement during the first 6–12 months to support new contract manufacturing partnerships in Asia. 25%–50% global travel

As Senior Program Manager, Contract Manufacturing Operations, you will lead this high-complexity transfer from integrated planning through manufacturing readiness, aligning suppliers and Veeco teams on schedule, quality, cost, and production objectives. Your work will strengthen the scale and execution behind technologies Veeco uses in advanced semiconductor fabrication and packaging. During this 6–12 month rotational assignment, you will establish the operating rhythm, controls, and supplier capability required for a successful ramp; after the assignment, you are expected to move into a broader Operations role supporting Manufacturing or Supply Chain, based on business needs.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
====================

* Own the end-to-end transfer of existing Advanced Packaging Lithography and Laser Annealing products to contract manufacturers in Asia, delivering production readiness against agreed schedule, quality, cost, and capacity objectives.
* Build and maintain the integrated program plan, critical path, decision log, risk register, and mitigation actions that keep supplier and Veeco workstreams aligned.
* Lead cross-functional execution across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and supplier teams, resolving system-level issues and clarifying ownership.
* Direct supplier training, early learning builds, and production-readiness reviews at supplier and Veeco locations worldwide, converting build results into closure plans and repeatable processes.
* Provide executive-level reporting on schedule, technical status, cost, resource needs, and risks, with clear decisions and recovery actions.
* Deliver operational-excellence and cost-reduction initiatives that improve manufacturability, throughput, quality, and total cost while protecting product performance.
* Establish durable governance, metrics, and escalation paths that enable contract manufacturing partners to sustain volume production after transfer completion.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 8 years of related experience leading engineering, manufacturing, or product-transfer programs for semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, or similarly complex capital equipment.
* Experience leading multiple concurrent programs that involve cross-functional teams, external suppliers, and executive stakeholders.
* Experience managing new product introduction or product-transfer work through manufacturing readiness and production ramp.
* Ability to travel globally 25%–50% during the 6–12 month rotational assignment.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**
====================================

* Working knowledge of Advanced Packaging Lithography and/or Laser Annealing equipment, or the ability to apply experience from comparable electro-mechanical and automated capital equipment.
* Expertise in integrated scheduling, critical-path management, risk management, budget control, resource planning, and executive reporting.
* Skilled at diagnosing system-level manufacturing issues and aligning engineering, operations, quality, and supplier teams on practical corrective actions.
* Knowledge of new product introduction, new product development, product lifecycle management, configuration control, and manufacturing-readiness practices.
* Ability to distill complex technical, schedule, and cost information into clear decisions and concise updates for executives and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Power BI, Smartsheet, enterprise resource planning and material requirements planning systems, and product lifecycle management tools; experience with SAP is preferred.
* Experience reading engineering drawings and working with computer-aided design tools such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD is preferred.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator II - AARS Project ADAPT
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** Monday - Friday, 9am -5:30pm
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a family of programs, is located across 13 different counties in California. HealthRIGHT 360 provides an array of medical and behavioral health services to some of the most marginalized populations, ranging from primary care, mental health services, detox, substance use disorder treatment in both residential and outpatient settings, and transitional services for the criminal justice population.
  
Asian Drug and Alcohol Prevention Treatment (ADAPT) is an adult outpatient program that provides culturally competent substance use and mental health services in English and Chinese. The AARS Project ADAPT offers a strengths-based, trauma-informed, harm reduction approach. Services include individual, group and case management services as well as acupuncture and access to free cultural/recreational events. We also have free community lunches and encourage developing supportive relationships and community. Our goals are to provide a safe and respectful counseling space for people from all walks of life and to reduce the impact of substance use and mental health conditions that lead to healthy, meaningful lives.
  
The Substance Use Counselor II at Project ADAPT works with a interdisciplinary team to provide substance use treatment, assessing client needs and strengths in support of health and recovery. The SUD II Counselor provides individual, group counseling using evidence-based curricula in accordance with program specific requirements (Drug Medi-Cal) as well as case management to assist clients in navigating systems of care and connecting to community resources (e.g. vocational, primary care, housing).
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:****Individual Treatment Responsibilities:**  

* May be required to carry a caseload of clients and facilitate weekly individual counseling sessions with each caseload participant.
* Provides clinical support and evidence-based interventions to support clients in meeting their treatment goals.
* Proactively links clients to both internal and external resources based on their treatment needs and follows up on their progress/status.

**This position is 100% in office!!!**

  

At **Muir Home Health** , we believe that home healthcare is more than just a service – it’s a commitment to enhancing the quality of life of every individual we serve. Nestled in the heart of the vibrant East Bay area of California, we are on a mission to revolutionize the way home health is perceived and delivered.

  

**Muir Home Health is growing and looking for an experienced and compassionate Scheduling/Intake Coordinator to join our team!** As a scheduling/intake coordinator with Muir Home Health, you will have the opportunity to advance your career while receiving strong compensation and excellent benefits.

* 401(k) plan with generous company match

Employee assistance program
