**JOB SUMMARY**

  

The Intake Coordinator/Scheduler is responsible for managing all aspects of the patient intake and staffing processes to support the operations of the Home Health Agency. This role serves as a central point of coordination, communicating directly with patients, families, referral sources, and internal staff to ensure seamless delivery of services.

Key responsibilities include overseeing patient intake, performing data entry, verifying insurance and obtaining authorizations, and facilitating daily intake stand-up meetings. The coordinator also manages clinician scheduling and workflow completion in Home Care Home Base, ensuring accurate alignment of patient needs with staff availability.

This position requires building and maintaining positive relationships with patients, families, clinical field staff, contract staff, and referral sources, while proactively responding to inquiries, resolving concerns, and maintaining accurate information to support efficient coordination of patient care services.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPSONSIBILITY**

  

* Direct and manage all daily patient referral, intake, and scheduling operations, including oversight of intake policies, procedures, and workflow efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with all state, federal, Medicare, and Joint Commission regulatory requirements related to intake, scheduling, and service delivery.
* Coordinate seamless patient transitions to home care by overseeing patient intake, education, plan of care initiation, and collaboration with multiple service providers.
* Verify insurance coverage, obtain authorizations, and support maximum third-party reimbursement, including negotiating service pricing within established guidelines.
* Manage clinician scheduling and staffing processes by maintaining accurate data on staff demographics, skill sets, availability, and productivity levels to align patient needs with appropriate resources.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound calls, responding promptly and professionally to patient, staff, and referral source inquiries and concerns.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with referral sources, patients, families, clinical staff, contract staff, and internal teams to support coordinated care delivery.
* Facilitate daily intake or staffing stand-up meetings and support clinical leadership by maintaining proper workflow and prioritization of tasks.
* Accurately complete and manage all scheduling-related workflows, including new referrals, missed visits, visit adjustments, recertifications, caseload reassignments, and staffing changes.
* Assist the Intake team by providing staffing solutions for new patient referrals and identifying needs for additional staff resources.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of contractual relationships with payers and contract staff, ensuring adherence to contract provisions and service requirements.
* Monitor, gather, and report referral and staffing metrics, including trends, productivity, and performance indicators.
* Support administrative functions for clinical and marketing teams and contribute to maintaining a high-quality reputation within the community.
* Assist leadership with budget planning, resource allocation, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, and commitment to ongoing growth and competency development.  

  

**BENEFITS**

* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* 401(k) plan with generous company match
* Critical illness benefit
* Paid time off
Employee assistance program

Muir Home Health **is part of the Cornerstone Group** with about 75 home health and hospice agencies throughout the country. **While we are part of a large family, we operate as a local team.** We understand we are nothing without great employees! It is through our team’s dedication to deliver life changing service that we become the “provider of choice” in the community that we serve. **Join a culture of high performers** who are on a mission to create the best Home Health agency in the East Bay!

  

**What makes us unique?** At Muir Home Health, we foster an environment where clinicians and staff members have an unprecedented level of freedom to create and implement the programs that will best serve their patients and communities. We operate with the Core Values of CAPLICO in mind:

* Celebration

Ownership

The **Quality Assurance Technician 1** is responsible for performing detailed inspections and quality control activities to ensure products meet internal standards and customer specifications. The Technician will support both in‑process and final inspection workflows in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

* Conduct **in‑process inspections** to verify product quality during various manufacturing stages.
* Complete **finished goods inspections** to ensure all outgoing material meets customer and internal specifications.
* Capture and document high-quality **inspection images** of components and products.

**Nonconformance Management**

* Identify nonconforming product and generate accurate, timely **nonconformance reports**.
* Partner with engineering teams to support investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions related to quality issues.

**Data & Documentation**

* Validate outgoing product data to ensure compliance with customer requirements.
* Perform accurate **data entry** and maintain up-to-date inventory information in the appropriate database systems.

**Job Summary**

The Administrative Manager provides operational leadership and day-to-day management for the UCSF Health Contact Center, Referral and Access Centers, and Call Center. Reporting to the Administrative Director, this role is responsible for ensuring efficient, high-quality service delivery, staff performance, and continuous improvement across assigned service lines and pods. The Administrative Manager directly supervises Administrative Supervisors and supports the strategic goals set by senior leadership while maintaining operational stability and excellence in patient and provider access services.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Provide direct leadership and supervision to Administrative Supervisors, including conducting 1:1 meetings, performance evaluations, coaching, and professional development.
* Oversee daily operations by rotating attendance in pod & Home Team Huddles/Meetings, providing intra-day oversight of inbound call queues and referral workqueues, monitoring operational trends, and resolving escalated issues from Supervisors (emails, chats, calls, etc.).
* Manage daily communications by checking and responding to messages (email, electronic medical record In-Box, instant messages, and Home Team Leadership inquiries), while covering Supervisor absences as needed.
* Lead weekly activities, including preparation and facilitation of Cross-Functional Huddles, Leadership Meetings, Director/Manager Meetings, weekly performance scorecard reviews, and development of action plans for metrics in negative variance.
* Review and respond to escalated trends, recurring issues, and errors from Supervisors, collaborating on solutions and escalating to the Administrative Director with action plans when necessary.
* Approve bi-weekly timesheets and manage time-off requests for direct reports and their teams.
* Attend and actively contribute to various team meetings (Director/Manager Meetings,UCSF and FPO Manager’s Meetings, and PDSAs), while leading Steering Committees and PDSA sub-team activities and presenting topics as required)
* Drive continuous improvement by submitting tickets, completing Leader Standard Work, reviewing Standard Work updates, and supporting training and quality improvement initiatives.
* Oversee staffing, onboarding, recruitment, and training activities, including precepting new Supervisors, creating daily staffing plans, and supporting go-live and pod stabilization efforts.
* Participate in ad-hoc activities such as special projects, performance management, new hire orientation and technology troubleshooting.
* Champion the Medical Center’s House and Telephone Standards and promote a culture of accountability, recognition, and exceptional customer service.
* Serve as a key liaison between Supervisors, frontline teams, service lines, and senior leadership to ensure alignment and timely resolution of operational issues.

**Department Overview**

The UCSF Contact Center is an integrated team that supports both patient and provider requests for access to care at UCSF Health. Administrative functions include 1) appointment scheduling, 2) referral intake, review and processing,3) coordinating any other administrative or clinical patient call-based requests to support effective care delivery.

The UCSF Faculty Practice Organization (FPO) is made of up of more than 2,500 clinicians across multiple campuses and satellite clinics. The UCSF Patient Care Access team supports the organization’s goal to be the #1 Health System in Northern California in health care value, patient experience, and employee engagement by ensuring our ambulatory clinics provide timely access to care for our patients. We strive to provide care when, where and how our patients need it. The team works closely with practices to support improvement efforts and with various departments across the organization (e.g., marketing, IT) to set strategic goals and develop innovative patient care.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent combination of experience / training.
* Five (5) years of supervisory experience in an Ambulatory Care/Access Center setting
* In depth clinic / center patient care management skills. Practice management knowledge in scheduling, customer-service methods, regulatory compliance, accreditation requirements, and / or information technology. Familiar with the policies, best practices, and standards involved with effective clinic / center administration. In-depth knowledge of patient population served and the requirements for the delivery of services.
* Proven ability to organize, manage multiple priorities, and delegate work functions efficiently.
* Demonstrated managerial skills and human resources management knowledge, including staff deployment, resource utilization, budgeting and financial management, quality improvement, and program planning and implementation.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communications skills to convey complex information, instructions, and guidelines in a clear, concise, and specific manner, and to influence and persuade all levels of staff.
* Knowledge of relevant healthcare and clinic operations information technology, including billing systems and patient care workflows and processes.
* Demonstrated knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, as well as related legislative, accreditation, licensing, and compliance environments.
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in nursing, health or the health care administration field
* Experience with ambulatory care clinical practices and/or Centralized Call/Referral Services
* Experience using EMR-EPIC/APeX.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager

### **What is Verse?**

The race to AI has become the race to power. Every breakthrough in artificial intelligence depends on one thing: access to electricity. But across the country, aging grid infrastructure and years-long interconnection queues are slowing the deployment of the data centers that will power the next generation of innovation. Solving this challenge isn't just about energy it's about unlocking the future of AI.

At Verse, we're building the energy intelligence platform for the AI economy. Our software helps the world's largest energy consumers achieve faster, cheaper, and cleaner power by combining real-time control of energy assets with complete visibility into their energy portfolio. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, Coatue, and NVIDIA, and built by pioneers in grid-scale batteries, energy markets, and enterprise software, we're redefining how the world's most ambitious organizations access and manage energy.

### **The Role**

We're hiring a **Customer Success Manager** to own the relationship and commercial outcomes for a portfolio of enterprise energy buyers after they sign. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for someone who knows renewable energy procurement inside and out and can be a trusted advisor to sophisticated energy and sustainability teams from day one.

You'll join a lean, fast-moving Customer Success function and help shape how it operates as we scale. A key part of this role is growing with Verse into **dispatch intelligence and battery storage optimization** real-time products that will define the next chapter of the platform. You'll be the person who makes sure our customers adopt the platform, realize value, renew, and grow.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the relationship, adoption, and commercial outcomes** for a book of enterprise accounts from signature onward.
* **Drive** **revenue** **retention**lead renewals, protect gross retention, and identify and close in-footprint expansion.
* **Serve as a trusted energy advisor****,** guiding customers on PPA/VPPA portfolio management, invoice and settlement validation, generation forecasting, availability and production guarantees, and REC/EAC management.
* **Run executive business reviews**, build account health scoring, and manage senior stakeholder relationships up the org chart.
* **Translate the platform's analytical outputs**into clear business value and confident reporting for your customers.
* **Partner cross-****functionally**with Sales on closed-won transitions and expansion, with Delivery on onboarding and implementation quality, and with Product to channel voice-of-customer into the roadmap.
* **Be a driving force in Verse's move into real-time dispatch intelligence and battery storage optimization** a central part of this role as those products scale.
* **Own your metrics**revenue retention, renewal rate, customer health, and referenceable customers.

### **What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* **4+ years**in customer success, account management, or client-facing advisory/consulting — ideally in energy, cleantech, or enterprise SaaS.
* **Deep, working knowledge of renewable energy procurement:**PPAs/VPPAs, RECs/EACs, and wholesale power markets (e.g., ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP).
* **A track record**managing large enterprise relationships and owning retention and expansion outcomes.
* **Comfort with data and analytics** able to interrogate technical outputs and turn them into a business narrative.
* **Outstanding executive communication****,** and the instinct to ask the probing questions that surface what a customer actually needs.
* **A builder's mindset**comfortable operating with ambiguity in a startup, and willing to travel to customers (~20–30%).
* **Bonus:**exposure to real-time energy markets, dispatch optimization, battery storage, or energy trading; a background in energy advisory or asset management; or experience helping stand up a customer success function.

### **What Makes Verse a Great Place to Work?**

* Lead with Empathy: We lift each other up with humility and kindness, always putting colleagues and customers first
* Be Honest & Transparent: We prioritize effective communication to build trust with our team, customers, and stakeholders
* Move with Balance & Precision: We believe speed and perseverance must be accompanied by thoughtfulness and reflection
* Leave the World a Better Place: We are passionate about our mission, and we strive to create a sustainable world for future generations

### **Base Pay Range**

**$115,000 - $150,000**

**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive.

We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**Office Manager, San Francisco**

Thomvest is looking for a Part time Office Manager to run our office in San Francisco's South Park neighborhood. This is the person who keeps everything humming, from the first coffee of the morning to the last guest out the door. For many founders, investors, and visitors, you'll also be the first face of Thomvest they meet.

**What You'll Do**

* **Office management.** Keep the office running smoothly day to day. You'll arrange repairs and maintenance, serve as the main contact with building management, keep the office and kitchen stocked and organized, and handle mail and packages.
* **Vendor and contract management.** Choose and manage the vendors who keep us going, including repairs, office equipment, security, cleaning, and catering. You'll keep an eye on contract renewals and costs, and manage the subscriptions and licenses for the tools the team relies on.
* **Investor and portfolio meetings.** Make our in-office board meetings, LP meetings, and portfolio company meetings run well. You'll handle scheduling, catering, AV, materials, and follow-up.
* **Team events.** Plan and host team events, offsites, and networking evenings, including our annual "ThomFest" holiday party. You'll also help with founder and portfolio events that grow Thomvest's presence in the Bay Area.
* **People operations.** Give every new employee, intern, and visitor a great start, with equipment, accounts, and building access ready on day one.
* **IT and systems.** Be the go-to person for office technology, including Wi-Fi, conference room AV, printers, and laptops. You'll coordinate with outside IT support when needed.

Our team is often traveling or in meetings, so you'll be the steady presence that holds the office together. Helping keep our culture both fun and mission-driven is a big part of the job.

The core of the role is clearly defined, but it doesn't stop there. It will grow with the firm's needs and with your own interests. You'll pitch in wherever help is needed, own special projects from start to finish, and find ways to make how we work a little better every day. With a small team of 2 to 4 people on site, you'll get a real view of venture capital up close and plenty of room to grow.

**Qualifications**

* Prior experience as an Office Manager. A startup background is strongly preferred.
* Comfortable working in both Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and Claude.

**Who You Are**

* **A hardworking self-starter.** You spot what needs doing and get it done without waiting to be asked.
* **An owner.** You treat the office as your own, see projects through to the end, and sweat the details.
* **Creative.** You're always looking for a better way, whether it's how the office runs or how we host our next event.
* **Friendly and outgoing.** You love meeting new people and enjoy being the one who makes founders, investors, and guests feel at home.
* **Passionate about startups.** The companies and founders we work with genuinely excite you.

**Compensation and Benefits**

jobs.description:
Position for Program Coordinator- St Jude Sub-Saharan African Regional Hub
  
This role if On-site in Johannesburg - South Africa, we are open to people that are willing to relocate, and also, we offer relocation allowance.
  
St. Jude Children's Research is a world-renowned institution dedicated to advancing cures and improving outcomes for children with cancer and other catastrophic diseases through exceptional research, clinical care, and education. The Department of Global Pediatric Medicine (GPM) at St. Jude Global (SJG) partners with governments, healthcare institutions, and international organizations to strengthen health systems, build clinical capacity, and expand equitable access to high-quality care worldwide. Sub-Saharan Africa bears a disproportionate burden of childhood cancer, with many children facing delayed diagnosis, limited access to specialised treatment, treatment abandonment, and significantly lower survival rates than those achieved in high-income countries. The World Health Organisation's Global Initiative for Childhood Cancer (GICC) aims to increase survival for children with cancer to at least 60% globally by 2030, through strengthened health systems and equitable access to quality care. As a principal partner in implementing the GICC, St. Jude Global collaborates with countries throughout Sub-Saharan Africa to enhance national childhood cancer programs, develop the pediatric oncology workforce, improve the quality of care, broaden access to essential medicines and diagnostics, and generate evidence to facilitate sustainable improvements in outcomes. St. Jude Global is expanding its Regional Programs to enhance collaboration and expedite impact across priority regions. The Regional Hub Program Coordinator will support the Sub-Saharan Africa Regional Hub by working in close partnership with the Regional Hub Program Manager and both regional and global stakeholders to coordinate programs, partnerships, and operational activities throughout the region. Situated within the Sub-Saharan Africa Regional Hub, the Program Coordinator will be responsible for comprehensive daily programmatic and operational support, thereby assisting in the effective planning, implementation, monitoring, and alignment of regional initiatives with the mission and strategic priorities of St. Jude. This role presents an opportunity to contribute to the establishment of new systems, processes, and partnerships aimed at enhancing outcomes for children with cancer and other catastrophic diseases across Sub-Saharan Africa.

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

Eliza is a technology services company and OpenAI partner dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy AI solutions. We combine technical expertise with hands-on client collaboration to solve problems that matter.

**Role Overview**
=================

We’re looking for a Partner Operations Manager to build and run the operating system behind Eliza’s OpenAI partnership. You’ll work across strategic partnerships, marketing, and go-to-market execution, helping our sellers make the most of key OpenAI relationships and helping promising opportunities move from referral to closed business.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn a strategic partnership into clear plans, useful assets, reliable follow-through, and measurable commercial impact. You’ll work closely with strategic sellers, marketing, delivery, and OpenAI stakeholders. You’ll help the team understand which relationships matter, what each opportunity needs next, and where the partnership is creating value.

**What You’ll Own**
===================

* Build the partnership operating model. Create and maintain the plans, stakeholder maps, operating cadence, systems, and playbooks that help Eliza manage the OpenAI relationship consistently.
* Equip strategic sellers. Give sellers the context and tools to navigate OpenAI relationships, including account and relationship maps, meeting briefs, follow-up plans, partner updates, and reusable sales materials.
* Move warm opportunities forward. Establish a clear process for receiving, qualifying, assigning, and tracking OpenAI referrals. Stay close to each opportunity with its owner, coordinate follow-up, surface blockers, and help move the work through the sales cycle to close.
* Coordinate partner marketing. Work with Eliza’s marketing team and OpenAI contacts on campaigns, events, workshops, announcements, customer stories, and other materials that build awareness and create qualified opportunities.
* Lead regular partnership reporting internally and with OpenAI. Maintain clear, accurate metrics on OpenAI relationships (mapping, targeting, and health); bi-directional lead flow (volume, size, and velocity); close rates; incentive usage and impact; team skills and certifications; invoicing and incentives against our SGA; customer evidence and WinWires; and other measures needed to understand and improve the state of the partnership. Turn reporting into clear updates, decisions, and follow-through.
* Improve what’s already in place. Maintain and improve existing HubSpot and OpenAI partner portal workflows, reporting, and partner activity tracking. Turn lessons from live opportunities into better processes and assets.
* Keep teams aligned. Make sure sellers, marketing, delivery, and leadership know the priorities, owners, next steps, and results across the partnership.
* Monitor OpenAI’s programs. Be Eliza’s central point of contact for staying current on OpenAI programs across marketing, go-to-market, and other areas. Translate changes into regular, practical updates for the right Eliza teams, including how to engage, Eliza’s current standing, and what actions or opportunities to pursue.
* Build customer evidence. Own post-engagement WinWire creation and publication in partnership with Eliza’s Marketing Lead, coordinating with delivery teams to capture outcomes and gather the needed inputs.

**How We’ll Know Performing Well**
==================================

* Eliza and OpenAI receive regular, useful reporting on relationship mapping, targeting, and health; two-way lead flow, including volume, size, and velocity; close rates; incentive usage and impact; skills and certifications; invoicing and incentives against our SGA; and customer evidence.

* Strategic sellers use the relationship context, playbooks, and materials you build.
* Partner marketing activity supports priority relationships and creates useful engagement with potential clients.
* Eliza can show how the partnership contributes to pipeline, closed business, and broader market visibility.
* The operating model gets easier to run and more useful as the partnership grows.
* Relevant Eliza teams receive timely updates on OpenAI program changes, Eliza’s standing, and clear guidance on how to engage.
* WinWires capture customer outcomes and are created and published after engagements in partnership with the Marketing Lead.

**What You’ll Bring**
=====================

---------------

* Experience in partner operations, strategic partnerships, go-to-market operations, partner marketing, or business development.
* Experience building repeatable processes, playbooks, and materials for a sales or partnership team.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, including defining partnership metrics, maintaining accurate CRM data, and turning operating data into useful internal and partner-facing updates. HubSpot experience is a plus.
* Experience coordinating campaigns, events, workshops, or other partner-facing programs.
* Strong project management and follow-through across several stakeholders and active opportunities.
* Clear writing and presentation skills, including the ability to make complex ideas useful to sellers and executives.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, or technology partnerships is a plus.

**Core Strengths**
------------------

* Commercial judgment. You understand how relationships, referrals, and partner activity can turn into real business.
* Systems thinking. You can make an ambiguous partnership easier to run by creating useful structure without adding unnecessary process.

Who We Are
  
Wellcove has been recognized as the nation’s leading full-service senior market solutions provider for over 25 years. Our solutions span the insurance senior market sector, focusing on long-term care and Medicare Supplement plans. However, we don’t stop there. Wellcove also addresses challenges faced in accident & health, disability, and supplemental health insurance programs.
  
  
Our team provides individuals and their families with peace of mind knowing their insurance needs will be met in a thoughtful, efficient manner. We are able to do this because of our dedicated associates, innovative solutions, and state-of-the-art technology.
  
  
Enrollment Specialist
  
Job Purpose
  
The Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) and Facility Enrollment Specialist is responsible for facilitating the enrollment of insureds who receive home care and facility services from provider agencies, independent caregivers, and facilities into the EVV and/or Facility program. This position primarily conducts outbound and inbound telephone outreach to educate stakeholders, guide them through the enrollment process, resolve questions, and ensure all enrollment requirements are completed accurately and timely.
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong communication, customer service, and organizational skills, with the ability to effectively manage multiple cases while maintaining compliance with applicable state, federal, and program requirements.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities:**  

* Conduct high-volume outbound and inbound phone calls to insureds, provider agencies, caregivers, and independent providers regarding EVV enrollment.
* Educate callers on EVV program requirements, enrollment procedures, deadlines, and available support resources.
* Guide stakeholders through the enrollment process, ensuring all required information and documentation are obtained.
* Assist providers with complete enrollment forms, account setup, and system access.
* Verify enrollment information for accuracy and completeness.
* Document all customer interactions, enrollment activities, and case notes in the appropriate systems.
* Follow up with insureds and providers to obtain missing information and ensure timely completion of enrollment.
* Respond professionally to questions, concerns, and enrollment issues while providing exceptional customer service.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to resolve enrollment-related issues.
* Monitor assigned enrollment cases and meet established productivity, quality, and service-level expectations.
* Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and comply with HIPAA and all applicable state and federal regulations.
* Stay current on EVV program requirements, policies, and system updates.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and compliance with EVV requirements.
* Provide training and guidance to clients on the use of EVV and Facility platforms, tools, and processes.
* Gather required information from claimants and caregivers and accurately record data in Wellcove’s platforms/systems.
* Maintain organized documentation for all client interactions, training sessions, and compliance activities.
* Provide outstanding customer service via phone and email, displaying professionalism, empathy, a sense of urgency, and a genuine willingness to help.
* Independently process caller requests accurately and promptly in Wellcove’s proprietary system and escalate as appropriate.
* Comply with customer support objectives and performance standards
* Effective use process resources to gain knowledge base and ensure the delivery of accurate information and error-free processing of requests
* Willingness to learn new duties and technology-related skills as required.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**  

* Proficiency with Microsoft office applications, Nitro, and the ability to learn multiple software applications.
* Accountable and able to work remotely and independently.
* Displays a positive ‘can do’/customer-first attitude.
* Ability to accurately document customer responses while simultaneously speaking with customers.
* Excellent communication skills and appropriate etiquette, great phone manners, and ability to speak with a wide range of personalities. Demonstrate a high level of proficiency in the use of the English language in oral and written forms.
* Collaborative team spirit.
* Ability to explain complex processes in a clear and easy-to-understand manner.
* Knowledge of HIPAA privacy requirements and confidentiality standards.
* Ability to meet performance metrics related to call volume, quality, and enrollment activation.
* Must have a dedicated remote work location free from background noises, interruptions, and desk clutter.
* Must have reliable internet connection and access to a smart phone.

**Education and Experience:**  

* High School or GED required
* Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**  

* Sedentary work. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
* Primarily remote call-center environment.
* Extensive telephone communication throughout the workday.
* Frequent computer use for documentation and enrollment processing.
* May require occasional overtime based on program or enrollment deadlines.

At Wellcove, we strive to create an inclusive culture for all. We understand the importance of listening and incorporating various perspectives at every level of service. Our company does not discriminate based on gender identity, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or disability.

jobs.title: Grant Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Want to make a difference? Join an organization committed to sharing the hope of true transformation with those impacted by incarceration for nearly 50 years. Prison Fellowship® is the nation's largest Christian nonprofit equipping the Church to serve currently and formerly incarcerated people and their families, and to advocate for justice and human dignity.

Prison Fellowship and its church partners encounter Jesus with those behind bars, breaking cycles of crime and prayerfully anticipating a revival of justice, mercy, and hope in our culture.

Prison Fellowship® is an organization committed to the highest standards of conduct, ethics, and Christian values. Our conduct is guided by and grounded in the Bible, as reflected in our Statement of Faith below.

**What We Are Looking For**

A highly organized, detail‑driven professional to provide operational leadership across Prison Fellowship’s full grant lifecycle—from proposal planning and development through award administration, reporting, and closeout. This individual will serve as the primary operational liaison to Relationship Managers, functioning as the “air traffic controller” who keeps timelines, reviews, submissions, and documentation coordinated and on track.

The ideal candidate excels at project management, cross‑functional collaboration, and maintaining accurate records across multiple systems. The right fit for this role is proactive, deadline‑driven, and committed to ensuring that every grant proposal and report is timely, accurate, donor‑centered, and aligned with Prison Fellowship’s mission.

**Role Responsibilities**

### **Grant Planning, Project Management & Coordination**

* Manage grant requests from intake through proposal development and approval
* Establish clear timelines, responsibilities, dependencies, and communication structures
* Coordinate participation across Relationship Managers, Grant Writers, Program Leads, Finance, Marketing & Communications, Development Services, Legal, and senior leadership

### **Grant Review, Submission & Award Administration**

* Facilitate the transition from proposal development to final submission
* Ensure proposals meet funder and organizational requirements
* Manage technical submissions through funder portals
* Oversee award documentation and operational setup for successful implementation

### **Post‑Award Management, Reporting & Closeout**

* Maintain visibility of grant commitments, deliverables, and deadlines
* Lead operational reporting and closeout processes
* Work across departments to identify risks, gather required information, and ensure timely, accurate reporting

### **Grant Systems Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate grant records in Salesforce, SharePoint, and grants‑tracking platforms
* Steward documentation, business rules, and performance measures
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and technology utilization
* Gather stakeholder feedback to strengthen grant processes

### **Foundation Prospecting & Pipeline Development**

* Identify, research, and evaluate prospective foundation funders
* Partner with Relationship Managers, Development Services, Prospect Research, and Program teams
* Translate research into actionable cultivation and qualification opportunities

**Key Qualifications**
----------------------

* 2–5 years of progressively responsible experience in grant administration, institutional fundraising, development operations, project management, or related nonprofit functions
* Bachelor’s degree in nonprofit management, business administration, project management, communications, public administration, or equivalent experience (Master’s degree preferred)
* Experience coordinating complex, deadline‑driven projects with multiple stakeholders
* Experience conducting foundation prospect research
* Experience working with CRM or grants‑management systems (Salesforce preferred)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Proven ability to collaborate across functional areas and maintain accountability without direct supervisory authority
* Familiarity with funder portals, project‑management tools (e.g., Smartsheet), and prospect research platforms (e.g., Foundation Directory, iWave)
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Ability to handle sensitive information with appropriate confidentiality

**Work Arrangement**
--------------------

* Remote/work‑from‑home position
* Up to 5% travel required

*Salary at Prison Fellowship is determined by a variety of factors. For this full-time position, the budgeted salary is projected to be $56,000-$65,000 annually.*

**Why Join Prison Fellowship**

At Prison Fellowship, we're committed to supporting the overall well-being of our employees through comprehensive benefits, generous paid time off, and opportunities for professional growth.

**Full-time employees enjoy:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and disability insurance
* Retirement account funding
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
* Paid maternity and parental leave
* Generous paid time off, including:
  + 14 paid holidays
  + 15 vacation days
  + 10 sick days
  + **39 total paid days off annually after one year of employment**
* Additional benefits and wellness resources

**Part-time employees** who regularly work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for select benefits on a prorated basis (excluding health insurance).

Beyond our benefits, you'll find a collaborative, mission-driven culture, supportive teammates, innovative technology tools, and meaningful opportunities for personal and professional development. **Join us in making a lasting impact while building a rewarding career.**

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - REMOTE WORK
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**  
Project Coordinator
  
  
**Location:**  
Remote (U.S. based)
  
  
FLSA Classification
  
  
Non-exempt
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Orbital is seeking a Project Coordinator to support the execution of utility engineering and construction projects in a REMOTE WORK role. This position will directly support projects for multiple departments as new projects develop. The work may include creation of notifications, work orders, invoicing, and financial reports, as well as transmitting deliverables to our Clients.
  
  
Essential Functions
  
  

* Provides administrative support to project team members
* Supports team in maintaining project related files, coordinating with vendors, invoicing, and managing purchase orders
* Supports project life cycle activities, including responsibilities related to Orbital project management software
* Regularly utilizes internal software packages to complete daily responsibilities in the engineering design workflow process
* Collaborate with Project Managers to ensure their projects are being executed according to proposed deadlines and constraints, and internal standards
* Assist with both internal and external reporting of project status KPIs
* Coordinate and compile input from team members and various project reports to establish appropriate project plans, checkpoints and processes to meet project milestones, financial metrics and requirements
* Communicate with others, including co-workers and clients, to reconcile project overages taking any corrective action required
* Assist management in the execution of internal QMS program to ensure first time quality in project management
* May be required to regularly interact with client personnel

Other Duties
  
  
Please note that this job posting does not list all duties and responsibilities that are required of this job. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
**Qualifications:**  

* Advanced computer skills for Microsoft Office Suite required
* Associates degree in relevant field or equivalent job experience required, Bachelor’s degree is a plus
* Effective written and oral communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with people individually and in groups, including external partners and internal team members
* Strong organizational skills with proven experience prioritizing work and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to work independently and contribute administrative support to teams
* Reasoning skills and ability to solve practical problems
* Experience with Deltek Vantagepoint preferred
* PMI certification preferred or knowledge of project management principles and processes is helpful
* EXCEL – Moderate to Advanced user is preferred
* Previous project or account management experience as a customer main point of contact is beneficial
* Experience with project start-up or close-out activities is preferred
* This position requires the ability to pass a post-offer drug (including marijuana) and alcohol test in compliance with Federal regulations and is also subject to random testing as a condition of continued employment.

**Location Note:**  
This is a remote position. Compensation is based on market data and internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s location.
  
  
**Salary Range:**  
$36,000-78,000 annually (based on experience, qualifications, and location)
  
  
**Benefits:**  
A commitment to excellence and hard work will be rewarded with a competitive salary, career advancement opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 401(k)-retirement savings plan; and supplemental insurance options. We also provide company-paid life and AD&D insurance, company-paid short-term disability coverage, company-paid maternity and bonding leave, and a generous paid time off program to ensure you have the support and flexibility you need both professionally and personally.
  
  
**About Orbital:**  
Powered by People, Driven by Solutions
  
  
Since 1969, Orbital has been specializing in project development, project execution and asset management for the heavy industrial sectors and utilities. Our regional offices, hands-on mentality, and world-wide integrated teams provide an ability to leverage subject matter experts and industry best-practices wherever a project may lie geographically. Our focus steadfastly remains on finding and delivering the best solution, regardless of where that team sits across our organization. At Orbital, our power is our people.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement:**  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

You’ll lead complex projects from both a technical and commercial perspective, partnering closely with customers while coordinating Field Service Representatives, contractors, and internal teams.

This role offers a unique blend of project leadership, customer relationship management, engineering support, and financial responsibility. You’ll also contribute to business planning by supporting financial forecasts and annual profit plans, developing cost estimates for proposals and change orders, and participating in commercial negotiations.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $104000 - $152000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Use modern project and program management tools and techniques to aid in the execution of projects related to the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrical power monitoring systems (EPMS).

* All candidates must reside within a 50-mile radius of the work locations listed. No relocation will be offered for this role. Active-Duty Military Service member candidates are exempt from the geographical area limitation.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution
* PMP Certified
* Previous experience in coaching/mentoring of field personnel.

* Successfully complete and maintain compliance with Eaton’s safety program and policy; This includes role-applicable portions of the EESS Qualified Electrical Worker (QEW) program and any required annual re-certifications thereafter.
* In-depth knowledge of Eaton Power Monitoring software (Power Xpert, PowerNet, Foreseer, Brightlayer)
* Submit to periodic customer required background and drug screenings.
* Strong organizational, project, time and task management skills, with use of personal computers and software systems to manage and track numerous priorities.
* Candidate needs to have a working knowledge of the overall sales function in regards to managing scope and necessary change order documentation
* Strong verbal communication; Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical personnel
* Demonstrated leadership and coaching/mentoring ability.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Lumenci is hiring a remote Customer Success Manager to deliver product demos and onboard new customers for iLumos, our AI-powered patent intelligence platform. In this fast-paced, customer-facing role, you will run live demos and discovery, handle objections, and help Sales close deals with law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors.

**About Lumenci**
=================

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform specializing in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetization for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumos platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

**Employment Type:** Full-time, exempt  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote  
**Location:** US  
**Reports To:** iLumos GTM Leader  
**Travel:** 10–15% (customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events)

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

iLumos is generating strong inbound interest from law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors, and we need someone who can turn that interest into customers. We are looking for an experienced demo professional who can join conversations quickly, show the product's value clearly, and help Sales close deals.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a professional with 3–5 years of experience who has delivered more than 100 product demos and brings energy, confidence, and presence to every conversation. You will own live demos, discovery, and new customer onboarding, then transition customers to our account team for long-term relationship management.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Product demos and discovery**

* Deliver live, tailored iLumos demos to prospective customers, often on short notice as new leads come in
* Run discovery to understand each prospect's workflows, priorities, and decision criteria
* Show how iLumos solves real patent and IP challenges in terms customers care about
* Adapt each demo to the audience, from patent attorneys and IP counsel to investors and executives

**Objection handling and deal support**

* Answer product, workflow, and value questions confidently during live conversations
* Handle objections and move conversations toward clear next steps
* Partner with Sales to advance opportunities and help close deals
* Support pilot programs by demoing and onboarding pilot users, while Sales owns the pilot
* Share prospect feedback and common objections with the GTM Leader and Product

**Customer onboarding**

* Lead onboarding for new customers so they start using iLumos quickly and confidently
* Walk customers through setup, core workflows, and best practices
* Transition customers smoothly to the account team once onboarding is complete, with a clear handoff of goals, stakeholders, and next steps

**Demo materials**

* Build and refine demo scripts, talk tracks, and objection-handling guides
* Help teammates deliver iLumos demos more consistently

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in a customer-facing software role, such as customer success, customer onboarding, pre-sales, solutions consulting, or product specialist
* Has delivered 100+ live product demos to business or professional buyers
* Experience at a patent, IP technology, or legal technology company
* Proven ability to run discovery, handle objections, and move prospects to next steps
* Experience onboarding new customers onto a software product
* Strong presence, energy, and communication skills in live conversations
* Availability to support demos on short notice during business hours
* Ability to travel 10–15% for customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events

**Preferred**

* Experience demoing AI, analytics, or data-driven products
* Familiarity with patent and IP workflows, such as prior art search, patent landscaping, portfolio analysis, or litigation support
* Technical, engineering, or legal background, such as a patent agent, engineering degree, or JD
* Experience with Salesforce or HubSpot

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**First 30 days:** Learn the iLumos product, customers, and core patent and IP workflows. Shadow demos and begin delivering them with support.

**First 60 days:** Deliver demos on your own and cover incoming demo requests promptly. Lead onboarding for new customers.

**First 90 days:** Consistently move demos to clear next steps with Sales. Onboard new customers and hand them off smoothly to Sales Enablement. Deliver a reusable demo script and objection-handling guide.

**Why You Will Love Working for Lumenci**
---------------

**CI Azumano Travel** is Seneca Holdings' full-service travel management company for businesses, governments, and personal travelers. We offer 24/7 support for travelers while also supporting customers with travel expense management, policy implementation, technology solutions, business intelligence tools, and vendor negotiations.

Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

In addition, they will position themselves within the client by developing multiple relationships to stay abreast of threats and opportunities for CI Azumano.

* Be the cheerleader for the clients internally by keeping all departments informed and focused on obtaining the clients' business goals.
* Ability to have tough and honest conversations with external and internal stakeholders.
* Proactively looks for objections and becomes the conduit to find solutions.
* Know your client better than your client contact.
* Create a "win-win" team approach to solve client issues.
* Understands the financial side of travel management and works in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to drive profitability by accessing and meeting a client's needs.
* Interprets contracts and provides guidance to internal stakeholders to meet client SLA's while staying in scope of deliverables.
* Proven negotiation skills that deliver value to the client while achieving or exceeding CI Azumano's corporate goals.
* Create annual business plans with customers that are measurable and tracks progress to goals.
* Develop and maintain professional working relationships with managers and staff to ensure maximum cooperation and achievement of service standards. Meet on a regularly scheduled basis to ensure all stakeholders stay connected to the customer.
* Promote the team's approach to meeting client needs and/or providing service correction.
* Position CI Azumano brand with industry suppliers and develop strong relationships for the benefit of the client and CI Azumano
* Work across department lines and represent clients while understanding the internal constraints of priorities in other areas.

  + Review and analyze the client's program performance and identify areas for improvement and cost savings.
  + Provide efficient problem resolution & escalation as necessary, detailed analysis and reporting, as well as, advice and counsel on the latest industry trends.
  + Coordinate with the client to develop a travel curriculum that will help the travelers stay informed on the latest trends in the travel industry.
  + Conduct training sessions live onsite or via video conference.

* College degree preferred.
* 5 years of experience in account management, client services, or travel management preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.
* Exceptional problem-solving, organizational, and analytical abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of financial travel program drivers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and reporting tools.
* Ability to travel 30% of the time.

jobs.title: Property Management Operations Manager - Scattered-Site Residential
jobs.description:
Run day-to-day operations for a 300-door third-party residential property management company in Chicagoland. You'll lead a six-person leasing, maintenance, and admin team so the owner can focus on growth. At some larger companies, this seat is called Director of Property Management.

**About Domain Property Management**

Domain Property Management is a third-party residential property manager based in Logan Square on the North Side of Chicago, Illinois. We manage nearly 300 scattered-site rental units across Chicagoland — single-family homes, condos, and small multifamily buildings — on behalf of individual owners and investors. We will continue to grow the company intentionally with the right clients and the right properties.

Our team of six works remotely across the US and abroad: leasing, maintenance coordination, and administration. We run on Aptly, AppFolio, RentEngine, and Property Meld.

**The role**

Your job is to own property management operations so the owner doesn't have to. The team handles the daily execution — showings, work orders, rent collection, move-ins and move-outs. You make sure it happens well, on time, and without the owner stepping in.

Three things stay on your desk personally:

* **Owner relations.** You are the point of contact for our clients — the property owners. You answer their questions, review their statements, and keep them confident their property is in good hands.
* **Escalations.** When a tenant issue, a vendor dispute, or a maintenance problem gets past the team, it comes to you. You resolve it.
* **Maintenance billing.** You review and approve in-house maintenance charges to owners so the numbers are right before they go out.

Everything else is leadership: setting priorities, holding the team to standards, fixing broken processes, and reporting to the owner on how the portfolio is performing. You report directly to the owner and have authority over day-to-day decisions, hiring recommendations, and team performance.

**What you'll do**

* **Lead the team.** Manage six US-based and international teammates across leasing, maintenance coordination, and admin. Set weekly priorities, run check-ins, coach, and hold people accountable to clear standards.
* **Own owner relationships.** Serve as the primary contact for property owners. Handle onboarding, questions, statement reviews, and renewals of our management agreements.
* **Handle escalations.** Take tenant, vendor, and owner issues that the team can't resolve and close them out calmly and fairly.
* **Oversee leasing.** Make sure vacancies are marketed quickly, showings happen, applications are screened consistently, and renewals go out on time. Watch days-on-market and occupancy.
* **Oversee maintenance.** With the maintenance coordinator, make sure work orders are triaged, dispatched, and closed promptly. Review and approve maintenance billing to owners and tenants.
* **Oversee turnovers.** Keep move-outs, make-readies, and move-ins moving so units are rent-ready fast.
* **Watch the money.** Monitor rent collection, delinquencies, owner distributions, and AP/AR with the admin team. Flag problems before they become owner calls.
* **Fix the process.** Keep HubSpot workflows, AppFolio, and Property Meld clean and used the way they're meant to be. When something breaks repeatedly, redesign it.
* **Report up.** Give the owner a weekly operations summary and a monthly portfolio review: occupancy, delinquency, maintenance spend, owner churn.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 3+ years at a third-party (fee-based) residential property management company managing single-family, condo, or scattered-site rentals. On-site multifamily, HOA/community association, or owner-operator experience alone is not a fit for this role.
* 1+ years leading or supervising others — a team, a pod, or an assistant and coordinators.
* Working knowledge of residential maintenance: you can read a vendor estimate, tell a reasonable repair from a padded one, and explain a charge to an owner.
* Comfortable managing a remote team, including teammates in other time zones.
* Hands-on with property management software (AppFolio, Buildium, Propertyware, or similar) and a CRM. HubSpot and Property Meld experience is a plus.
* Clear, professional written and spoken English — you'll be the voice to owners.
* Calm under pressure and decisive. Escalations end with you.
* Based in the US and able to work Central Time business hours.

**Not required, but helpful**

* Experience in the Chicago-area rental market or Illinois landlord-tenant rules (RLTO, CRLTO, security deposit law).
* Illinois real estate broker or managing broker license
* Experience at a company that grew from under 200 doors to 500+.

**How to apply**

All communication will be through indeed. Please submit your application. If your application meets our initial renew, you will be contacted for a follow up.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* Are you based in the U.S. and willing to work Central Time business hours?
* 1. Have you worked for a third-party (fee-based) property management company that manages properties owned by other people?

Work Location: Remote

The Project Manager ensures the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of assigned clinical research projects. The Project Manager I must ensure compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements. These tasks are done under close supervision by Senior Project Manager/Program Director and/or Associate Director, Project Management

**This role will be perfect for you if:**

* We can count on you to deliver results while using a disciplined approach to project management
* You are looking for the next career step to prepare you to become a project manager.
* You are knowledgeable about clinical research projects and looking to continue learning.
* Working in an organization that is driven by science and innovation and completing meaningful work is important to you.

jobs.title: Project Manager II, dermatology and rheumatology CRO,USA
jobs.description:
The project manager II has the overall responsibility for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of assigned clinical trials. The project manager II oversees and coordinates study resources to ensure compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements. Project Manager II acts as the main line of communication to relevant stakeholders and provides input to feasibility, study design, budget development and ensures progress reporting (resources, budget and timeline)

**This role will be perfect for you if:**

  

* You want to work for a mid-sized CRO that works on significant multisite trials, including Global Phase III projects
* You are looking to position yourself in an environment where you can grow your career alongside the company

**IMPACT AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**﻿****Client interactions**

* Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor
* Provide efficient and timely updates on trial progress
* Lead client calls effectively

**Project planning**

* Oversee and actively participates in the preparation of project deliverables such as; study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report.
* Participate in the planning and conduct of the Investigator’s Meeting.
* Ensure that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).
* Lead study start-up activities including trial kick-off, TMF setup, site selection and activation, vendor set-up timelines, and site contracting and budgeting.
* Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs to ensure timely submissions and completeness of essential documents prior to site initiation and throughout the study.
* Partner with Data Management to ensure CRF alignment with protocol and sponsor requirements, and that data review, query resolution, and database lock timelines are met.

**Quality and risk management**

* Ensure assigned studies are “audit ready” at all times.
* Monitor the quality of study deliverables, (including vendor and SubCRO deliverables) and address issues as they arise.
* Manage risk and control measures to assure project quality.
* Analyze discrepancies between planned and actual results.
* Review and approve responses to quality assurance audits.

**Project budget and timelines**

* Control the project budget, with particular attention to internal hours allocated to all activities.
* Identify out of scope activities for change orders.
* Proactively manage operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinate tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.
* Communicate effectively with study team members, functional departments, and senior management.
* Manage and report on recruitment status and highlight initiatives needed to meet recruitment timelines.

**Project team leadership**

* Lead the core project team which may include: Associate Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Project Assistants.
* Ensure all team members have adequate training on the project.
* Work closely with vendors and the following internal teams to ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed on time, according to plans and according to applicable standards: Site Selection, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management, Clinical Monitoring, Biostatistics, Scientific Affairs.
* Define and maintain the project-specific training matrix and ensure training records are kept up to date throughout the study.

  
Requirements:  
  

**Education**

* B.Sc. in a related field of study to clinical research

**Experience**

* At least 5 years industry experience and a minimum of 3 years in Phase I-III clinical trial project management
* Experience managing dermatology and/or rheumatology trials
* Experience leading concurrent multi-centered clinical trials with budgets in excess of $3M USD.
* Experience managing dermatology trials an asset

**Knowledge and skills**

* Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, FDA and Canadian regulations
* Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
* Excellent oral and written skills in English, French is an asset
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors
* Good problem-solving abilities
* Good organizational skills
* Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines

  
Brand name:
  
Indero  
  
Our company:  
  

**The work environment**

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

* Flexible work schedule / work schedule :
* Home-based position
* Ongoing learning and development

**About Indero**

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology and Rheumatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

***Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.***

***Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in the United States.***

jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Project Manager works closely with sites and is a liaison between Voiant, the study sponsor and the CRO for executing the study protocol with Voiant.

**Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

· Consistently performs duties within established Policies, Standard Operating Procedures, Work Instructions, and Study Specific Procedures in accordance with current GxP standards and applicable regulations (e.g., Good Clinical Practices, Good Documentation Practice, 21 CFR Part 11/Annex 11, MHRA, GDPR, HIPPA).

· Reviews Project Management Plan and with sponsor and CRO to:

o define training and communication plan for sponsor, CRO, and sites.

o facilitate communications and data information flow between Voiant and sponsor’s designated data management vendor to meet sponsor data delivery timelines.

o facilitate communications and data information flow between Voiant and sponsor’s designated CRO to maximize study site performance.

· Provides online access and training to sponsors, CRO and data/safety management on content with Voiant systems.

· Tracks certification progress at study sites to meet sponsor timelines by monitoring Voiant Study Forms and addressing uncertified site issues with appropriate CRO and Voiant staff members.

· Assists and advises Sponsor/CRO with site selection as requested.

· Conducts training for sites, sponsors and CROs on Voiant study protocol specific site procedure manuals and other Voiant processes as determined by the Director of Global Services

· Monitors content of the company’s Status Report with sponsor and CRO to obtain forms and images from sites within timelines needed to generate company data for all protocol analysis time points.

· Provides ongoing study site compliance matrices to sponsor and CRO; identifies sites needing re-training or re-certification on company study protocol procedures on as-needed basis and addresses them with appropriate Voiant and CRO staff members to obtain resolution.

· Assists CRO in monitoring site staff / contact information and verifying that required site Voiant certifications remain current in Voiant STUDY FORMS throughout the study.

· Assists sites, sponsor, and CRO in tracking queries to resolution in timely manner via the company status report.

· Coordinates technical staff support with study sites and tracks technical issues to resolution in support of the Project Manager.

· Meets with Sponsor and CRO at regular intervals to maintain site compliance in study via the Voiant Status Report, adjunct reports, and company procedure manuals when requested by the Director of Global Services

· Provides periodic newsletter or supplemental study information about Voiant, site performance, etc., to sponsor and CRO on regular basis when requested.

· Attends interim and recurring teleconferences and webcasts related to study training and management when requested by the Director of Global Services

· Coordinates details of the company’s data delivery method and schedule between Voiant data team and sponsor / CRO data team for ad hoc data transfers.

· Develops and implements study closure plan with sponsor, CRO, and sites.

· Maintains an updated CV on file with the Quality Assurance team.

· Maintains current all assigned training and training documentation.

· Answers incoming phone calls from sponsors, CROs, and sites and redirect calls as appropriate.

· Monitors inflow of screening/baseline and follow-up study subject forms and images.

· Performs QC check of incoming forms and images and issues queries as needed.

· Archives pertinent study specific documents in M Files.

· Executes internal protocol change control document with company staff when an active study Amendment is received.

· Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Experience**

· 4-year college degree

**OR**

· High school diploma or equivalent and minimum 2+ years’ experience in conducting or monitoring studies at a clinical research site

**OR**

· High school diploma or equivalent and minimum 5+ years’ experience working in a general ophthalmic practice.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

* It is preferred that the candidate has previous experience with Ophthalmology, Medical Device, Pharmaceutical or the Clinical Research Industry and with regulations & standards such as GCP, FDA 21 CFR 320 and 812.

a. How many years of experience do you have?

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Iron Bow Technologies is for people who believe trust is paramount, transformation is embraced, and the future is here, because **"What we do matters**!"

We are a next generation solutions provider, delivering mission success across government, healthcare, and commercial industries. Iron Bow relies on our **passionate people**, **long standing partnerships**, and **strategic thinking** to solve your most critical challenges.

Whether we team with clients, colleagues, or partners, we put each other first. It’s **The** **Iron Bow Way.**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We’re looking for a Program Manager who will manage and oversee several large IT program initiatives for the Federal and State, Local, and Education (SLED) Governments . The Program Manager will be responsible for the planning, direction, and coordination of all activities of the designated Programs including developing an understanding of client business needs and providing thought leadership for our clients. In addition, the Program Manager is responsible for exploring ways to expand and grow solutions and services opportunities with existing clients, reducing costs and increasing profitability. The PM will ensure that goals and objectives of the programs are accomplished within scope, schedule, resource, and quality parameters, as defined within the executed Statement of Work (SOW) and/or Customer Contract.

**HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT**

* Lead high-complexity programs operating in service-driven, high-availability, or compliance-focused environments, ensuring alignment with long-term business strategy.

* Produce/present quarterly and annual program reviews for both internal/external customers
* Conduct regular Program Management Reviews (PMRs) and risk assessments, adjusting plans as necessary to maintain alignment with organizational priorities.

* Proactively identify program issues and develop reasonable and appropriate solutions

* Assist with program recompetes
* Additional duties as assigned

**SKILLS THAT DRIVE SUCCESS**

* Bachelor’s Degree and PMP certification
* 10+ years Program Management experience working IT support for Federal and State customers
* You have vast experience working within the Federal and SLED space driving the execution Programs
* You are able to orchestrate the overall customer experience, while delivering to the program objectives
* You have a strong understanding of financial, risk, deliverable, and resource management
* You have experience conforming with contract regulations and performance of obligations within the contractual agreement and strong ability to interpret and manage Government and non-Government contracts
* You have a high attention to detail and extensive writing/presentation skills, as effective communication is critical within this role
* You are proficient in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams.
* You have the ability to work independently and in a matrixed team environment
* Ability to prioritize requirements and meet deadlines
* Ability to balance a large volume workload and learn in a fast-paced environment
* Be able to present to C-level Executives and be able to demonstrate presentation skills during the interview process.
* Regular and reliable attendance.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

* This position is remote but may require 20% travel.

**WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT!**

* Be a leader in providing the highest level of customer experience excellence in a fast past and exciting environment
* Iron Bow is rapidly growing and with growth comes opportunity for all. There is palpable energy and momentum across the company that is easy to tap into and be inspired by.
* Be a part of organizational transformation. Now’s the time to join. Iron Bow is redesigning the customer and employee experience. This new approach elevates all and truly enables success.

* Coordinate stakeholders across People and partner functions to keep complex work moving.
* Conduct research, gather stakeholder input, synthesize findings, and develop recommendations to support decisions.

* Support projects involving topics such as People policy, new program design, operating model changes, compliance readiness, employee programs, or other emerging business needs.
* Partner with the appropriate functional owners and subject matter experts so that specialized work remains with the teams accountable for it.
* Adapt quickly when priorities change, including pausing, redirecting, or closing work cleanly when leadership changes course.

* Maintain visibility into progress, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
* Build practical documentation, playbooks, and processes that make programs repeatable and scalable.

jobs.description:

Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Are you ready to work making the world a safer, healthier place? Join our mission to continuously move science forward; to innovate and advance all aspects of our business to improve the health and safety of our communities and lives.

Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
