Compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s geographic location, relevant experience, education, skills, and alignment with internal equity. Market conditions, budgetary considerations, and organizational compensation guidelines may also influence the final offer.*

**Make an Impact. Build a Career.**

At Pace®, everything we do is built upon an unwavering commitment to making the world a safer, healthier place. Since 1978, we’ve continued developing innovative practices that drive sustainability and empower our partners with accurate quality data at every critical moment and milestone.

That's why we need you - your curiosity, your talents, and your drive - to help us advance this important work, and your career.

We’re seeking curious, motivated individuals who are passionate about protecting our environment and the communities we serve. If you’re looking to develop your skills, contribute to meaningful scientific work, and build a long-term career in environmental science, Pace® could be the perfect place for you.

**Find Your Place at Pace®**

Join us as a **Client Project Coordinator**, where you’ll provide critical administrative and coordination support to our Project Management team. In this on-site role, you’ll act as a liaison between project management and sample receiving/log-in to ensure smooth intake, setup, and execution of client work.

**This is a remote opportunity, but candidate must be within driving distance of one of our labs for training and onsite availability in Mansfield, MA.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Oversee, review, complete, and process project management forms, documents, databases, and related information
* Serve as a liaison for client project needs, providing guidance and recommended actions to internal Pace® teams to ensure successful project setup
* Direct client calls and requests to the appropriate Project Manager for follow-up
* Schedule and enter bottle orders into the container order system based on client sample needs
* Review login dashboards and update information and confirmations as needed
* Assist with project management and cross-functional initiatives, including budgets, timelines, materials, staffing, and project requirements
* Interpret and apply department policies and procedures; assist with compliance to applicable laws, rules, and regulations with guidance as needed
* Contribute to departmental efficiency by offering suggestions for improvements
* Promote Pace’s mission through professional, courteous, and cooperative interactions with clients and coworkers

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, chemistry, biology, or a closely related field

We are seeking an AI Operations Specialist to help business and product teams use AI to take on review and quality work. You will map how work gets done today, build AI-driven workflows, and test them until the results can be trusted. You will also help product teams decide whether an AI feature is ready to launch. ### **Key Responsibilities**

* Help prioritize projects by business impact and make the case for the ones worth pursuing.

jobs.description:
We provide a white-label payment platform for e-commerce merchants. It combines payment orchestration, connections to multiple acquirers and a built-in CRM for customer and order management. We serve both high-risk merchants and traditional online stores, with the same level of care for each. We are a lean, founder-led team, and this is a key role in scaling our merchant portfolio.

**The role**

You will be the single point of contact for our merchants, from signed contract to day-to-day operations. You will onboard them, train them on the platform, monitor their performance and solve problems before they turn into losses. You will report directly to the founder.

**What you’ll do**

**Merchant onboarding**

* Run kick-off calls to understand each merchant’s business model, volumes, markets and products.
* Collect the required KYC/KYB documents and make sure each file is complete and readable.
* Send each file to our platform partner’s compliance team, then follow up until it is approved.
* Configure accounts: acquirer routing, 3DS, descriptors, currencies and fraud rules.
* Support technical integration (checkout, API, plugins, webhooks) until the first successful transaction.

**Training & enablement**

* Deliver demos of the CRM: orders, subscriptions, refunds and reporting.
* Build our knowledge base: guides, short videos, FAQs and onboarding checklists.

**Portfolio management**

* Monitor approval rates, chargebacks, refunds and volumes for each merchant.
* Flag chargeback risks early and recommend corrective actions.
* Hold regular check-ins with key accounts and spot upsell opportunities, such as new MIDs or new markets.

**Support**

* Act as first-line support by email, Telegram and WhatsApp for declines, held funds, reserves and settlements.
* Escalate issues to the platform with clear tickets and follow them through to resolution.

**Reporting**

* Send a weekly update covering onboarding pipeline, volumes, incidents and risks.

**What we’re looking for**

**Must-have**

* 2–5 years of experience in online payments, at a PSP, acquirer or payment orchestrator, or on the merchant side.
* Solid understanding of acquiring, MIDs, MCCs, 3DS, chargebacks, card scheme monitoring programs, reserves and settlement.
* Comfort with technical topics: you can read API documentation, test a webhook and interpret a decline code.
* Ability to work autonomously and remotely while managing 20–40 merchants at a time.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with high-risk merchants.
* Knowledge of e-commerce or subscription CRMs, or of fraud prevention tools.
* Spanish or another additional language.

**Soft skills**

* You explain payment issues clearly to non-technical merchants.
* You stay calm and solution-oriented when funds are on hold.
* You treat compliance as a priority and never push a dubious file through for volume.

**What we offer**

* Fully remote position with working hours aligned to European time zones.
* Fixed monthly fee plus a performance bonus based on the margin generated by your portfolio.
* Contractor status to start, with a 2-month trial period and room to grow as the business scales.
* Direct impact and close collaboration with the founder.

Pay: $1,000.00 - $10,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Revenera helps product executives build better products, accelerate time to value and monetize what matters. Revenera’s leading solutions help software and technology companies drive top line revenue with modern software monetization, understand usage and compliance with software usage analytics, empower the use of open source with software composition analysis and deliver an excellent user experience—for embedded, on premises, cloud, and SaaS products.

**Location:** Remote (North America, PT/MT time zones preferred)

**About Revenera**

Revenera helps software and technology companies monetize, manage, and protect their software across subscription, SaaS, usage-based, perpetual, and hybrid business models. Our solutions help organizations optimize software licensing, entitlement management, software delivery, and usage analytics while accelerating digital transformation and recurring revenue growth.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Customer Success Manager directly influences customer retention, growth, and long-term success by driving adoption, value realization, risk mitigation, and strategic account expansion.

You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Professional Services, Support, Executive Sponsors, and Engineering to ensure customers achieve their desired business outcomes throughout the customer lifecycle.

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence customer strategy, revenue growth, customer advocacy, and product adoption across a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers, responsible for driving business outcomes and long-term value realization.
* Develop and execute Customer Success Plans that align customer objectives with measurable business outcomes, adoption strategies, and success metrics.
* Lead executive engagement through business reviews that demonstrate value, track progress, highlight risks, and identify future growth opportunities.
* Drive adoption and utilization of Revenera solutions to strengthen retention, improve customer outcomes, and accelerate expansion opportunities.
* Identify and advance growth opportunities by aligning Revenera capabilities to evolving customer business priorities and objectives.
* Implement proactive risk mitigation strategies that improve customer health, reduce churn risk, and protect recurring revenue.
* Build customer advocacy by increasing customer satisfaction, referenceability, and executive sponsorship.
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Renewals, Professional Services, Product Management, Support, and Engineering to ensure seamless customer lifecycle execution.
* Influence account strategies by delivering data-driven customer insights and aligning resources to customer priorities.
* Translate complex customer use cases, technical requirements, and software monetization challenges into clear business value for executive stakeholders.
* Act as the voice of the customer to influence product direction, customer programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technology or business-related field, preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in technology, consulting, or enterprise account management roles within a software or technology company.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth and customer retention within a SaaS, software, or technology environment.
* Proficiency with CRM and customer success tools such as Salesforce and Gainsight.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to understand customer strategies, identify opportunities, manage risk, and connect solutions to measurable business outcomes.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to navigate complex enterprise environments involving multiple stakeholders, business priorities, operational processes, and technical requirements.
* Proven ability to translate complex customer use cases and business challenges into actionable success strategies that deliver measurable value.

**What Makes You Successful**

* You think strategically and focus on outcomes, not activities.
* You thrive in complex customer environments and can confidently engage both technical teams and executive decisionmakers.
* You use strong business judgment to uncover opportunities, navigate challenges, and guide customers toward successful outcomes.
* You can simplify complex concepts and communicate value clearly to diverse audiences.
* You proactively identify risks and opportunities before they impact customer success.
* You influence cross-functional teams effectively and drive alignment around customer priorities.
* You leverage AI and modern productivity tools to streamline research, uncover insights, and work more effectively.
* You are passionate about helping customers achieve measurable business results and long-term value.

**Why Join Revenera?**

At Revenera, you'll work with some of the world's leading software and technology companies as they transform how they monetize software, adopt subscription and SaaS business models, leverage usage intelligence, and pursue new opportunities in AI-driven and consumption-based revenue strategies.

You will play a direct role in helping customers achieve their business objectives while influencing retention, growth, and long-term success for both our customers and Revenera.

**GNCO, Inc. | Independence, OH (Remote)**

jobs.title: Account Manager, MarketSmart
jobs.description:
**About Dynatron**  
Dynatron is transforming the automotive service industry with intelligent SaaS solutions that deliver measurable results for thousands of dealership service departments. Our proprietary analytics, automation, and AI-powered workflows help service leaders increase profitability, elevate customer satisfaction, and operate with greater efficiency.  
  
With accelerating demand and an expanding product ecosystem, we’re scaling quickly. Building a predictable, efficient revenue engine is critical to our next stage of growth.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Account Manager, MarketSmart is responsible for driving cross-sell and upsell revenue by expanding adoption of MarketSmart and MarketSmart Recalls within Dynatron’s existing customer base across the Central United States. This quota-carrying role owns territory coverage, pipeline generation, and the full sales cycle, with a focus on converting customer opportunities into recurring subscription revenue.  
  
Success requires a proactive, self-directed sales professional who can independently generate leads, build relationships with automotive dealership decision-makers, and consistently achieve revenue targets with limited BDR support.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Revenue Growth & Quota Attainment**

* Achieve assigned annual recurring revenue (ARR) quota through sales of MarketSmart and MarketSmart Recalls.
* Identify and close cross-sell and upsell opportunities with existing Dynatron customers who do not currently use the applicable products.
* Drive product adoption and recurring revenue growth across the assigned territory.
* Maintain an accurate sales forecast and consistently monitor progress against quota.

**Pipeline Generation & Territory Management**

* Independently build and manage a qualified sales pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, and targeted account research.
* Develop and execute territory plans to maximize account coverage and revenue potential.
* Identify customer needs and product gaps to prioritize high-potential sales opportunities.
* Maintain consistent prospecting activity and pipeline health with limited business development support.

**Consultative Selling & Sales Execution**

* Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, product demonstrations, proposals, negotiations, and closing.
* Engage dealership owners, general managers, and relevant marketing or fixed operations decision-makers to understand business needs and demonstrate product value.
* Articulate the business value of MarketSmart and MarketSmart Recalls through consultative, outcome-focused selling.
* Follow established sales processes and ensure opportunities, signed sales orders, and supporting documentation are accurately maintained in the CRM.

**Customer Relationships & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Build trusted relationships with existing Dynatron customers to identify expansion opportunities and support long-term customer value.
* Partner with Customer Success, Sales Operations, and other internal teams to coordinate customer engagement and facilitate successful sales outcomes.
* Represent Dynatron professionally in the automotive market to generate leads, referrals, and new opportunities within the existing customer base.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or SaaS sales, preferably in a quota-carrying role.
* Demonstrated success generating pipeline independently and achieving revenue targets.
* Experience selling to automotive dealerships or within automotive technology is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage a consultative sales process from initial outreach through close.
* Strong prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivated, results-oriented, and comfortable operating with limited BDR support.
* Ability to manage a multi-state territory and travel as needed.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

* Achievement of assigned ARR quota.
* Qualified pipeline generation and coverage across the assigned territory.
* Cross-sell and upsell revenue from eligible MarketSmart and MarketSmart Recalls subscriptions.
* Conversion rates, sales cycle effectiveness, and forecast accuracy.
* Consistent CRM compliance and adherence to sales and contracting processes.

**Compensation & Commission Eligibility**
-----------------------------------------

This is a quota-carrying role with base salary and eligibility for variable commission compensation under Dynatron’s applicable sales compensation plan. Commission eligibility is governed by the plan’s definitions of eligible revenue, assigned territory, required sales documentation, approved contract terms, and applicable performance requirements.  
**Why Dynatron**

* Combine automotive expertise with a career in high-growth B2B SaaS.
* Help dealerships turn technology and data into measurable business results.
* Own meaningful, long-term customer relationships rather than transactional interactions.
* Work closely with Product, Sales, Support, Implementation, and Client Success teams.
* Remote-first environment offering flexibility, autonomy, and accountability.
* Clear expectations, measurable outcomes, and opportunities for continued professional growth.

**Benefits Include**

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Equity participation through Dynatron's Equity Incentive Plan
* Employer-paid disability and life insurance
* 401(k) with competitive company match
* Flexible vacation policy and 11 paid company holidays
* Home office setup support
* Remote-first working environment
* Ongoing professional development

If you're an Automotive SaaS Client Success professional who knows how to turn technology, data, and trusted customer relationships into measurable dealership results, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

As an Account Manager for our Health and Wellness vertical, you are responsible for driving expansion growth within our customer base. Your primary responsibility will be to foster strong relationships with existing clients, identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, and ensure their continued satisfaction and loyalty to our software solutions and services.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within the existing customer base through phone, video, email and face to face to understand their business goals and challenges.
* Create and execute strategic account plans to identify growth opportunities and drive expansion within assigned accounts.
* Deeply understand customers business needs and match to qualifying products and solutions.
* Identify and pursue opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional products and services that align with customer needs and objectives.
* Serve as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for their needs and ensuring they receive the highest level of service.
* Proactively manage contract renewals, ensuring high renewal rates and preventing churn.
* Collaborate with the Customer Success team to ensure customers are successfully adopting and leveraging our solutions to achieve their desired outcomes.
* Address and resolve customer issues and concerns in a timely and effective manner, coordinating with internal teams as needed.
* Maintain an accurate record of sales activities, leads, and opportunities in the CRM system. Develop and manage a sales pipeline of opportunities to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets. Leverage sales dashboards to understand where to focus your time and activities.
* Provide regular updates and reports on account status, growth opportunities, and customer satisfaction metrics to management.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to think strategically and identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
* Strong understanding of sales processes and techniques for upselling and cross-selling.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and persuasively.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to address and resolve customer issues effectively.
* Deep commitment to customer satisfaction and success, with a proactive and customer-centric approach.
* Ability to analyze customer data, market trends, and account metrics to inform strategy and decision-making.
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
* In-depth understanding of the software technology industry and market dynamics.
* Outstanding knowledge of MS Office and proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and customer success tools.
* Fast and adaptative learner, focused on improving customer and business processes.
* Advanced negotiation skills.
* Driven by achieving and exceeding targets, with a strong focus on results.

**Experience and Education Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in software sales, preferably within the SMB and mid-market segments.

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $130,000-$140,000 USD

Includes base salary plus commission.

jobs.title: Account Manager (Mid Market)
jobs.description:
**About Storable**
------------------

At Storable, we're redefining property management for specialty real estate. Powered by AI and three decades of industry data, Storable empowers over 33,000 self-storage facilities with the industry's only fully integrated technology platform.

Our end-to-end solutions—from management software and demand generation to CRM tools and delinquency solutions—help storage operators streamline workflows, attract tenants, and grow revenue. Dedicated to empowering self-storage owners and operators, Storable helps you Win More every day. Explore our platform solutions at storable.com.

**Overview**
------------

Storable is seeking a commercially minded **Account Manager (Farmer)** to grow Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) within an assigned book of existing Mid-Market or SMB customers.

In this role, you will convert usage trends, facility growth, and product whitespace into expansion bookings. You will partner closely with the Customer Success Manager (CSM), who owns product adoption and the mechanical execution of the renewal, stepping in to lead commercial terms when the renewal requires restructuring.

**What You'll Do Every Day**
----------------------------

* **Account Planning & Whitespace:** Build account plans for priority accounts using account scores and whitespace analysis by revenue line.
* **Expansion Execution:** Run defined expansion plays, including facility adds, Easy-to-Edge upgrades, and Marketplace opt-ins.
* **Pipeline Conversion:** Identify expansion opportunities and convert them—alongside signals surfaced by the CSM. Own the pricing, proposal, and contract processes for expansion.
* **Forecast & Operations:** Maintain a highly accurate expansion pipeline and forecast in Salesforce, providing clear visibility into segment performance.
* **Cross Functional Alignment:** Own the identification and closure of expansion opportunities. Collaborate with cross functional teams to identity and accelerate sales cycles though collaboration and team-selling.

**What You Need to Bring**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of Account Management, Customer Success, or closing Sales experience in B2B SaaS, with a primary focus on upselling and cross-selling existing accounts.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate account whitespace and run data-driven expansion plays.
* Strong commercial negotiation skills, specifically dealing with add-ons, co-terms, and contract restructuring.
* Collaborative mindset, with a history of partnering successfully with Customer Success teams to drive account growth.
* Rigorous pipeline management and forecasting skills using Salesforce.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience in the self-storage, property management, or broader real estate technology sectors.
* Familiarity with integrated payments, marketplace solutions, or embedded insurance portfolios.
* Training in formal sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, Command of the Message, Sandler).

**Work Authorization**
----------------------

All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Storable is a fully distributed company and currently employs individuals residing in all U.S. states except Alaska, Hawaii, and New Hampshire.

About Us:

At Storable, we're redefining property management for specialty real estate. Powered by AI, our end-to-end platform seamlessly integrates management software with marketplace listings, websites, CRM, insurance, payments and more. Tailored for self-storage, marine, and RV & camping operators, Storable helps you Win More every day.

Benefits and Perks:

* Generous health coverage for you and your family, including fully paid short- and long-term disability coverage and two-times base salary life insurance.
* 401(k) match after 60 days, 100% vested after 1 year.
* Employer contribution to your HSA, plus an HRA to help offset your deductible.
* Instant access to flexible vacation. We trust you, so we have a 'take what you need' vacation policy.
* Be More – company rewards and recognition that add up and can be redeemed for personalized gifts and experiences! Storriors have been able to enroll in SCUBA certification classes, travel overseas, and redo their back patio, among many other things.
* 8 hours of Volunteer Time Off each year and the opportunity to get active in the community by joining one of our offsite volunteer and community service events.
* 8 hours of Rest, Relax, Recharge time to care for your mental health.
* Access a range of mental well-being resources for yourself and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness workshops
* Fully paid parental leave: 12 and 6 weeks for primary and secondary caregivers, respectively.
* 'Paw'ternity Leave and Pet Bereavement - we understand that pets are a part of the family and have generous time-off policies, which honor that commitment.
* Caregiver Leave: four weeks of fully paid time away from work to care for aging dependents or family members, if needed.
* $50 monthly home data stipend, plus a home office sign-on bonus of $250.
* Fertility care support options to help in your journey towards parenthood.

Mosai™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. With Mosai, home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at https://www.mosai.com/

jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager

Salted is the largest delivery-first restaurant group in the United States, and we're hiring a Customer Experience Manager to be the standard-bearer for culinary excellence and customer experience across our kitchens.  
This is a hybrid role: part trainer, part auditor, part culture-carrier. You'll be the knowledge-bearer and teacher of culinary spec at Salted by setting brand expectations, recipes, and cooking methods, training new kitchen teams and launching new brands, auditing for consistency, and closing the loop between what customers experience and what kitchens execute. You'll thrive here if you excel in fast-moving, occasionally unstructured environments and have a track record of developing a culture of culinary excellence.  
  
**What You'll Do**  
**Training & Launches**

* Successfully train and launch high-impact brands in kitchens through culinary demos, mock service, and hands-on instruction
* Train new kitchen teams for new location launches, including spec, process, and organization
* Train the trainers at the District Manager and Kitchen Manager levels so standards cascade through every level of the business
* Build and maintain training materials, playbooks, and prep/par guides for every brand
* Provide training for new teams being onboarded as needed

**Spec, Quality & Consistency**

* Identify gaps in spec, retrain, and set clear expectations around culinary standards wherever they're needed
* Audit kitchens for food quality, consistency, and compliance with brand specs
* Review regular line checks and provide immediate, actionable feedback to field management
* Conduct remote line checks, secret shops, and camera reviews

**Customer Experience & Communication**

* Communicate rollouts and updates on menus, recipes, equipment, ingredients, and other key changes
* Close the feedback loop by resolving kitchen feedback tied to menus, recipes, equipment, and ingredients
* Cover kitchen operations in emergency scenarios to keep service running without interruption

**What You Bring**

* Extremely organized and detail-oriented, with strong analytical thinking
* Excellent written and verbal communication and comfortable giving direct, concise feedback to trainees and management
* High ownership and follow-through; self-motivated with a track record of getting things done
* Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and minimal structure
* A natural teacher and mentor, energized by developing people at every level
* A customer-focused mindset and excellent problem-solving ability

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of professional culinary, kitchen management, or kitchen training experience in a restaurant or quick service environment
* Experience training across multiple food concepts, cuisines, or brands
* Current food safety certification (e.g., ServSafe), or willingness to obtain one
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel 50%+ of the time to kitchen locations
* Comfortable using digital tools such as Slack, Opsi, spec libraries, and virtual kitchen/training platforms
* Acts as a hands-on role model for food quality, consistency, and kitchen hygiene
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus

  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Line Check Audits: 98% or higher
* Positive Customer Feedback Rate: 90% or higher
* Key Brand Weekly Order Ratings: 4.8 or higher

**Salary**  
$80-90,000/year, plus incentive-based performance bonuses  
  
**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans
* 401(k) with up to a 4% employer match after one year
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid Family Leave
* Remote-based role, with travel to kitchens across the country
* Real career advancement opportunities as we continue to grow

*Salted is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive team. If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact hr@hellosalted.com.*

jobs.description:
**Momentum Life Sciences helps the healthcare industry connect, motivate, and empower people to engage in their health.**

By combining the power of real, personal connections and the convenience of technology, Momentum delivers solutions that drive better health and business outcomes.

**Who We Are:** Momentum is a leading provider of patient and healthcare professional engagement solutions with more than 30 years of experience in the healthcare industry.

**What We Do:** We partner with life science companies to design, build and deliver effective and efficient patient support programs helping patients achieve a better start and longer stay on therapy.

**How We Do It:** Our patient engagement and Clinical Nurse Educator platform delivers personalized, evidence-based human and digital interventions.

**About the Position**

The Non-Clinical Case Manager provides personalized support to patients and caregivers through inbound and outbound interactions across assigned patient support programs. This role builds trusting relationships, uses open-ended questions and active listening to understand patient needs, and applies motivational interviewing techniques to explore goals and barriers to engagement.

Responsibilities include communicating approved program information, connecting patients with resources, coordinating follow-up, and helping patients navigate concerns and identify appropriate next steps. Working collaboratively with program partners and internal teams, the Case Manager applies critical thinking, maintains accurate documentation, and follows established guidelines to deliver a consistent, compassionate patient experience.

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* Provide personalized inbound and outbound patient and caregiver support through approved communication channels, including telephone, email, chat, and text, according to program requirements and established timelines.

* Build rapport and establish trusting relationships through empathy, active listening, emotional intelligence, and patient-centered communication.

* Utilize open-ended questions, reflective listening, and motivational interviewing techniques to understand patient concerns, explore goals, identify barriers, and encourage meaningful engagement.

* Communicate approved program information, available services, and resources clearly, adapting conversations to individual patient needs while confirming understanding.

* Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to clarify concerns, identify unresolved needs, evaluate available resources, and determine appropriate next steps within established program guidelines.

* Collaborate with patients and caregivers to identify realistic next steps, coordinate appropriate resources, and follow through on agreed-upon actions.

* Effectively guide patient conversations, balancing human connection, patient needs, required discussion points, and call objectives while maintaining compliance with approved call guides.

* Recognize questions or requests outside the scope of approved program services and respond according to established procedures without providing medical advice or clinical recommendations.

* Manage assigned cases, outreach activities, and follow-up responsibilities, prioritizing time-sensitive tasks and maintaining continuity of support across interactions.

* Maintain accurate, timely, thorough, and objective documentation of patient interactions, identified barriers, actions taken, outcomes, and follow-up needs within designated systems.

* Demonstrate proficiency in navigating multiple technology platforms, including customer relationship management (CRM), telephony, and documentation systems, while maintaining attentive and engaging patient conversations.

* Collaborate effectively with internal teams and approved program stakeholders to coordinate support, share relevant information, and facilitate resolution of patient needs.

* Maintain working knowledge of assigned programs, approved resources, workflows, and processes to confidently address patient questions within the role's scope.

* Meet established productivity, quality, documentation, and service expectations while maintaining a patient-centered approach.

* Identify opportunities for process improvement and participate in training, coaching, quality calibration, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Demonstrate adaptability, accountability, and receptiveness to feedback while navigating changing program requirements and operational priorities.

* Ensure all activities comply with Momentum Life Sciences (MLS), client, and applicable industry regulations, policies, and procedures.

jobs.title: Clinical Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Clinical Product Operations Specialist**
==========================================

**Hello Alpha** | Full-time | Remote | Reports to the Chief Medical Officer

**About Hello Alpha**
---------------------

Hello Alpha is a telemedicine company. Our team of engineers, clinicians and operators builds the web platform that patients, care teams and partner organizations use every day.  
  
**Alpha Values:**

* **We are mission-driven -** We’re changing the paradigm of healthcare for patients who are historically underrepresented due to sex, race, gender, language, economic status, location, disability, and other diverse backgrounds. We empower our Primary Care Providers with a foundation in women’s health to administer patient-centered care throughout a woman’s lifespan.
* **We put patients first -** We prioritize what’s best for our patients, not what’s easier or more profitable. We do whatever it takes to provide excellent care and empower patients to take control of their health.
* **One team, One Dream -** We work together as a team to bring to life our vision of a more just healthcare system. We trust each other, communicate openly and honestly. We give credit where it is due, provide opportunities for employee growth and development, assume good intentions, and celebrate our wins as a team.
* **Diversity is at our core -** Alpha exists to bring a more accessible, equitable system to care for the whole woman regardless of age, income, and location. We are inclusive, welcoming, and value different perspectives.
* **We are data-driven -** Alphanauts love data and value facts over opinions. We use evidence-based science to highlight the clinical value of our mission.
* **We are proactive and positive -** Alphanauts learn by doing and address challenges without waiting or worrying about their scope. We are pragmatic and value progress over perfection. We are optimistic and believe in the power of positivity.

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring a Clinical Product Operations Specialist to be the connective tissue between product, engineering, our care team and our partners. You will own three things end to end: the content that powers our patient-facing experience in Contentful, the data requests that keep the business informed in Amazon QuickSight, and the bug triage process that keeps our platform reliable. You will also write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) that make our work repeatable, act as the product expert for our clinical team, and help shape how we plan, ship and communicate releases.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Manage content in Contentful**

* Create, review and publish content entries, and keep a calendar of scheduled changes.
* Run a QA pass in our staging environment before anything patient-facing goes live.
* Keep content structure, naming and permissions consistent, and archive what is outdated.
* Write clear requests to engineering when a content type needs to change, and verify the result.

**Own data requests and reporting in QuickSight**

* Run a single intake process for data requests so every ask has an owner, a purpose and a deadline.
* Build and maintain QuickSight dashboards, and turn recurring requests into self-serve reports.
* Write SQL for ad hoc analysis and define key metrics so numbers match across reports.
* Check reports against underlying data before they go to partners, finance or leadership.
* Handle patient data responsibly by pulling only what each request needs.

**Run bug tracking and triage**

* Collect bug reports from our care team, support and partners, and link duplicates.
* Reproduce issues in staging and write up clear recaps with steps, expected and actual behavior, and screenshots.
* Lead a weekly bug review, verify fixes before closing, and update the person who reported each issue.

**Be the product expert for our clinical team**

* Know the patient dashboard and the care-team dashboard well enough to answer "how does this work?" from clinicians and clinical operations.
* Be the first point of contact for clinician questions and workflow issues; resolve what you can and escalate the rest.
* Be the owner of EMR (e.g., Athena) and resolve integration issues with EMR tech support
* Translate clinical workflow needs into clear, well-scoped requests for product and engineering.
* Walk clinicians through new features and changes, and bring their feedback back to the product team.
* Keep clinician-facing guides and training material accurate as the product changes.

**Keep product operations running**

* Coordinate releases: draft release clinical SOPs, write and maintain SOPs for recurring work across product, clinical and operations teams, such as content QA, data requests, bug triage and release checks.
* Support partner onboarding with checklists, test accounts and user acceptance testing.
* Send a regular update on content, data and bug queues, and keep the Jira backlog organized for clinical/operations requests

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 2-4 years in product operations, business operations, analytics or a similar role, ideally in health tech or healthcare.
* Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a BI tool such as QuickSight, Tableau or Looker.
* Experience managing content in a headless CMS, ideally Contentful.
* Experience managing EMR workflows, ideally Athena.
* Experience triaging and documenting bugs in Jira.
* Clear, concise writing: tickets, SOPs and updates that others can act on without a meeting.
* Ability to explain a technical product to non-technical clinical colleagues, and to turn their needs into clear requests for engineers.
* A careful, organized approach, and comfort working with sensitive health data under HIPAA.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Content modeling experience in Contentful.
* Experience writing SOPs or training material in a clinical or regulated environment.
* Familiarity with Amazon Redshift and dbt.
* Background in telemedicine, pha

jobs.description:
Who We Are

**Our mission is simple but critical: to build pathways for adult learners to earn high-quality, workforce-aligned degrees and credentials from North Carolina’s public universities.**

**At Project Kitty Hawk, our work reflects our company values:**

**Collaboration** – We prioritize our partners’ success and reputation, aligning every initiative with their goals, reflecting their values, and enhancing their impact.

**Innovation** – We innovate, not replicate. As creative problem solvers, we use data-driven insights to push boundaries, continuously improve our services, develop solutions, and redefine what it means to serve nontraditional learners.

**Empathy** – We understand the unique challenges of nontraditional learners, and are committed to supporting them with empathy, respect, and solutions that fit their needs.

**Integrity** – We operate with transparency and accountability in everything we do. We uphold honesty, take ownership of our work, and maintain the highest standards.

**Teamwork** – We embody the collaboration we seek. We always strive to be dependable, supportive, and solutions-oriented teammates.

Together, we partner with universities in the University of North Carolina (UNC) System to produce innovative, flexible degree and credential programs in high-demand fields. Each PKH team member plays a vital role in advancing this mission and shaping the future of education for adult learners.

These values will enable us to realize PKH’s vision: to make North Carolina’s public universities the top choice for adult learners and to amplify the UNC System’s role as a national leader in higher education innovation, access, and student success. By joining our team, you have an opportunity to contribute to our achievement of that vision, in the process helping to create opportunities for thousands of learners to earn their success and move up the economic ladder.

At Project Kitty Hawk we hire talented people who are not only dedicated to our mission but share our belief that working together makes us stronger and more effective. In this organization you’ll find individuals with a range of interesting backgrounds and life stories; the true magic happens when those individuals come together to solve problems in service of a common goal.

### **The Role**

The Re-Enrollment Specialist (RES) is the primary point of contact for students who have stopped out before completing a degree and want to complete their degree at a UNC System institution. The RES leads the outreach to students, including calling contacts and prioritized segments, understanding the challenges students encountered before stopping out and what stands in the way of returning, and guiding them to the right readmission pathway at the appropriate UNC System institution.

### **What you'll do:**

* Execute high-volume outbound contact (call, text, email) to stopped-out students, prioritizing campaign responders and assigned segments in alignment with established cadences and content guidelines.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand each student’s reasons for stopping out, current goals, and barriers to return.
* Guide students through their next step, from selecting a pathway to starting the readmission or re-entry application, and confirm a warm handoff to the appropriate campus contact.
* Manage a personal pipeline in the CRM (Education Cloud), maintaining accurate dispositions, campus of origin and destination, and next actions.
* Monitor individual metrics, including contact rate, conversations, application starts, and campus handoffs, and take corrective action to improve results.
* Conduct long-term nurturing follow-up to student completers to gather information on student experience, success, and retention
* Develop and maintain working knowledge of the readmission policies, processes, and deadlines of each participating UNC System institution, including readmission versus new-application rules, time-away thresholds, academic standing and suspension requirements, holds, and transfer-credit considerations.
* Use the Re-Enrollment campus knowledge base to identify the correct pathway for each student’s situation and set accurate expectations about requirements and timelines.
* Apply System and campus operating rules on where a student may return (e.g., home-campus-first) and escalate exceptions or unclear cases to the REM.
* Capture structured, consistent data on stop-out reasons, barriers, and outcomes so the program can segment, prioritize, and report accurately.
* Share regular feedback with the REM on messaging performance, list and data quality, and recurring student objections to inform campaign and cadence adjustments.
* Flag policy changes, process friction, and discrepancies between published campus policy and student experience, and contribute updates to the knowledge base and team playbooks.
* Close the loop with campus partners on handoffs, confirming receipt and tracking returned outcomes to identify where students stall after reconnection.
* Partner with the REM and campus re-enrollment, registrar, and admissions contacts to resolve student questions and smooth the path back.
* Collaborate with PKH Marketing, Operations, and Analytics teams on campaign timing, list updates, and reporting.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all student records and CRM data in the RES’s personal pipeline.

### **What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 1+ years of experience in higher education admissions, advising, re-enrollment, or student recruitment, OR equivalent experience in high-volume outbound outreach or customer success.
* Preferred: Experience with readmission or registrar processes, adult and “some college, no credential” learners, or the UNC System.
* Comfort and consistency with high-volume outbound calling, including persistence and resilience with cold and re-engagement outreach.
* Ability to learn, compare, and accurately apply differing policies

**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $750M in bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for home services: three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome), one shared platform.

**About Product at LawnStarter**

Our BHAG: 1+ job per household, every year. Getting there means winning on four fronts at once: more customers, more Pros, excellent service for both sides, and an AI-run company that moves faster than its size should allow.

**About the First Service Experience at LawnStarter**

Every new customer meets us the same way. They land on our home page or marketing site, then move through a signup and booking flow where they get a quote, pick a service and a schedule, and pay. That flow runs across all three brands and brings in most of the company's new customers.

We built it many years ago. It's too long, and we lose customers at too many steps. So the real question isn't how to remove a step. It's whether the experience designed still makes sense at all, or whether it should be rethought entirely as an AI-native, agentic experience.

**The Role**

You'll own the consumer's first service experience: everything from the moment someone first encounters LawnStarter through signing up and booking their first service. You'll decide what that experience should become, then build it with engineering, design, operations, marketing, and data.

This is not a funnel-optimization job. We want someone who looks at a five-year-old flow, asks what a homeowner would want if we started from nothing today, and then ships the answer.

As Lead PM, you're an individual contributor with Lead-level scope and no direct reports. You'll work closely with the Consumer Experience lead, the Pro Experience PM, the Pricing PM, and the Conversational AI & Agents lead. You'll report to the Sr. Director of Product.

**What makes this role different:**

* **A rebuild, not a tune-up.** You're rethinking the experience from first principles, not polishing the one we have.
* **AI-native from the first screen.** You'll decide whether a form is even the right way to sign up anymore.
* **Every new customer passes through your work.** Across three brands, this is how people meet LawnStarter.

**What You'll Own**

* **The vision:** What the first service experience should become, and the plan to get there.
* **The home page and marketing site:** The first impression, and the first decision a customer makes about us.
* **Signup and booking for all three brands:** LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome.
* **Funnel data:** The numbers that show where customers move forward and where they leave.
* **Quotes, services, and scheduling:** How a customer gets a price, picks a service, and chooses when it happens.
* **Payment:** Checkout, including Apple Pay and Google Pay.

**Problems to Solve**

**Deciding whether today's experience should exist at all.**  
You'll start from what a homeowner needs to book their first service and work backward. Every step we have today has to earn its place again, and you'll defend each call with evidence.

**Designing an AI-native, agentic way to sign up.**  
Someone who wants their lawn mowed shouldn't have to learn our product to book it. What can an agent handle for them, and where does a person still want control? You'll answer with prototypes in front of real customers, not opinions in a meeting.

**Rebuilding without breaking what works.**  
This flow brings in most of our new customers. You'll need a path that proves the new experience works with real customers before it replaces the old one. Bold and careful at once: that's the job.

**Moving levers you don't own.**  
Signup touches pricing, Pro supply, and operations. Change how customers book and you change what Pros see and how jobs get priced. You'll work through the people who own those levers and bring them along on a vision that changes their world too.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* A vision leadership rallies behind: A clear picture of the reimagined first service experience, grounded in what customers need.
* A first piece of it, live: A meaningful part of that experience shipped to real customers. Not a deck.
* Signup conversion goes up: More of the people who find us become customers.
* More customers sign up for their first service: The reimagined experience gets more households to that first booking.
* First service CSAT is high: Customers rate their first service experience highly (customer satisfaction, CSAT).

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are:**

**Experience:** Customer obsessed with 6+ years in consumer product management, focused on consumer experience.

**A visionary who ships.** You look at an experience everyone has accepted and ask why it exists. Then you build the replacement. Is your instinct to improve what's there, one step at a time? Then this isn't your role.

**Customer-obsessed, for the long run.** You care whether a customer converts and whether they're glad they did. Short-term signups never win over the customer's experience in your book. Someone who'd juice conversion at the customer's expense won't last here.

**An AI builder.** You've shipped AI-powered or agentic consumer experiences. You prototype new signup experiences with LLMs and agents, read customer transcripts to hear where people get stuck, and use AI to pull apart funnel data in an afternoon. If you've only watched AI from the sidelines, this role is unlikely to be a good fit.

**Your own analyst.** You run your own funnel analysis and product analytics, and you know which step loses people before anyone builds you a dashboard. If you need someone else to pull your numbers, this is unlikely to be a good fit.

As A1J Technologies transitions from a traditional precision machining job shop into a scalable Tier 1 supplier supporting commercial aerospace and defense customers, this position plays a critical role in strengthening program accountability, cross-functional coordination, customer communication, and on-time delivery performance.

This position is responsible for maintaining accurate program status, identifying and escalating execution risks, coordinating recovery plans, monitoring program milestones, and ensuring customer commitments are supported by realistic manufacturing schedules and available resources.

Enrollment Specialist

This position primarily conducts outbound and inbound telephone outreach to educate stakeholders, guide them through the enrollment process, resolve questions, and ensure all enrollment requirements are completed accurately and timely.

Lumenci is hiring a remote Customer Success Manager to deliver product demos and onboard new customers for iLumos, our AI-powered patent intelligence platform. In this fast-paced, customer-facing role, you will run live demos and discovery, handle objections, and help Sales close deals with law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors.

**About Lumenci**
=================

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform specializing in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetization for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumos platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

**Employment Type:** Full-time, exempt  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote  
**Location:** US  
**Reports To:** iLumos GTM Leader  
**Travel:** 10–15% (customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events)

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

iLumos is generating strong inbound interest from law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors, and we need someone who can turn that interest into customers. We are looking for an experienced demo professional who can join conversations quickly, show the product's value clearly, and help Sales close deals.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a professional with 3–5 years of experience who has delivered more than 100 product demos and brings energy, confidence, and presence to every conversation. You will own live demos, discovery, and new customer onboarding, then transition customers to our account team for long-term relationship management.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Product demos and discovery**

* Deliver live, tailored iLumos demos to prospective customers, often on short notice as new leads come in
* Run discovery to understand each prospect's workflows, priorities, and decision criteria
* Show how iLumos solves real patent and IP challenges in terms customers care about
* Adapt each demo to the audience, from patent attorneys and IP counsel to investors and executives

**Objection handling and deal support**

* Answer product, workflow, and value questions confidently during live conversations
* Handle objections and move conversations toward clear next steps
* Partner with Sales to advance opportunities and help close deals
* Support pilot programs by demoing and onboarding pilot users, while Sales owns the pilot
* Share prospect feedback and common objections with the GTM Leader and Product

**Customer onboarding**

* Lead onboarding for new customers so they start using iLumos quickly and confidently
* Walk customers through setup, core workflows, and best practices
* Transition customers smoothly to the account team once onboarding is complete, with a clear handoff of goals, stakeholders, and next steps

**Demo materials**

* Build and refine demo scripts, talk tracks, and objection-handling guides
* Help teammates deliver iLumos demos more consistently

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in a customer-facing software role, such as customer success, customer onboarding, pre-sales, solutions consulting, or product specialist
* Has delivered 100+ live product demos to business or professional buyers
* Experience at a patent, IP technology, or legal technology company
* Proven ability to run discovery, handle objections, and move prospects to next steps
* Experience onboarding new customers onto a software product
* Strong presence, energy, and communication skills in live conversations
* Availability to support demos on short notice during business hours
* Ability to travel 10–15% for customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events

**Preferred**

* Experience demoing AI, analytics, or data-driven products
* Familiarity with patent and IP workflows, such as prior art search, patent landscaping, portfolio analysis, or litigation support
* Technical, engineering, or legal background, such as a patent agent, engineering degree, or JD
* Experience with Salesforce or HubSpot

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**First 30 days:** Learn the iLumos product, customers, and core patent and IP workflows. Shadow demos and begin delivering them with support.

**First 60 days:** Deliver demos on your own and cover incoming demo requests promptly. Lead onboarding for new customers.

**First 90 days:** Consistently move demos to clear next steps with Sales. Onboard new customers and hand them off smoothly to Sales Enablement. Deliver a reusable demo script and objection-handling guide.

**Why You Will Love Working for Lumenci**

new_jobs.title: Property Management Operations Manager - Scattered-Site Residential
new_jobs.description:
Run day-to-day operations for a 300-door third-party residential property management company in Chicagoland. You'll lead a six-person leasing, maintenance, and admin team so the owner can focus on growth. At some larger companies, this seat is called Director of Property Management.

**About Domain Property Management**

Domain Property Management is a third-party residential property manager based in Logan Square on the North Side of Chicago, Illinois. We manage nearly 300 scattered-site rental units across Chicagoland — single-family homes, condos, and small multifamily buildings — on behalf of individual owners and investors. We will continue to grow the company intentionally with the right clients and the right properties.

Our team of six works remotely across the US and abroad: leasing, maintenance coordination, and administration. We run on Aptly, AppFolio, RentEngine, and Property Meld.

**The role**

Your job is to own property management operations so the owner doesn't have to. The team handles the daily execution — showings, work orders, rent collection, move-ins and move-outs. You make sure it happens well, on time, and without the owner stepping in.

Three things stay on your desk personally:

* **Owner relations.** You are the point of contact for our clients — the property owners. You answer their questions, review their statements, and keep them confident their property is in good hands.
* **Escalations.** When a tenant issue, a vendor dispute, or a maintenance problem gets past the team, it comes to you. You resolve it.
* **Maintenance billing.** You review and approve in-house maintenance charges to owners so the numbers are right before they go out.

Everything else is leadership: setting priorities, holding the team to standards, fixing broken processes, and reporting to the owner on how the portfolio is performing. You report directly to the owner and have authority over day-to-day decisions, hiring recommendations, and team performance.

**What you'll do**

* **Lead the team.** Manage six US-based and international teammates across leasing, maintenance coordination, and admin. Set weekly priorities, run check-ins, coach, and hold people accountable to clear standards.
* **Own owner relationships.** Serve as the primary contact for property owners. Handle onboarding, questions, statement reviews, and renewals of our management agreements.
* **Handle escalations.** Take tenant, vendor, and owner issues that the team can't resolve and close them out calmly and fairly.
* **Oversee leasing.** Make sure vacancies are marketed quickly, showings happen, applications are screened consistently, and renewals go out on time. Watch days-on-market and occupancy.
* **Oversee maintenance.** With the maintenance coordinator, make sure work orders are triaged, dispatched, and closed promptly. Review and approve maintenance billing to owners and tenants.
* **Oversee turnovers.** Keep move-outs, make-readies, and move-ins moving so units are rent-ready fast.
* **Watch the money.** Monitor rent collection, delinquencies, owner distributions, and AP/AR with the admin team. Flag problems before they become owner calls.
* **Fix the process.** Keep HubSpot workflows, AppFolio, and Property Meld clean and used the way they're meant to be. When something breaks repeatedly, redesign it.
* **Report up.** Give the owner a weekly operations summary and a monthly portfolio review: occupancy, delinquency, maintenance spend, owner churn.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 3+ years at a third-party (fee-based) residential property management company managing single-family, condo, or scattered-site rentals. On-site multifamily, HOA/community association, or owner-operator experience alone is not a fit for this role.
* 1+ years leading or supervising others — a team, a pod, or an assistant and coordinators.
* Working knowledge of residential maintenance: you can read a vendor estimate, tell a reasonable repair from a padded one, and explain a charge to an owner.
* Comfortable managing a remote team, including teammates in other time zones.
* Hands-on with property management software (AppFolio, Buildium, Propertyware, or similar) and a CRM. HubSpot and Property Meld experience is a plus.
* Clear, professional written and spoken English — you'll be the voice to owners.
* Calm under pressure and decisive. Escalations end with you.
* Based in the US and able to work Central Time business hours.

**Not required, but helpful**

* Experience in the Chicago-area rental market or Illinois landlord-tenant rules (RLTO, CRLTO, security deposit law).
* Illinois real estate broker or managing broker license
* Experience at a company that grew from under 200 doors to 500+.

**How to apply**

All communication will be through indeed. Please submit your application. If your application meets our initial renew, you will be contacted for a follow up.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* Are you based in the U.S. and willing to work Central Time business hours?
* 1. Have you worked for a third-party (fee-based) property management company that manages properties owned by other people?

Work Location: Remote

This role directly manages the primary school leader and at each school will work directly with principals, directors, and school leadership teams to ensure schools are operationally strong, well‑supported, and positioned to serve students successfully.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Product Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Clinical Product Operations Specialist**
==========================================

**Hello Alpha** | Full-time | Remote | Reports to the Chief Medical Officer

**About Hello Alpha**
---------------------

Hello Alpha is a telemedicine company. Our team of engineers, clinicians and operators builds the web platform that patients, care teams and partner organizations use every day.  
  
**Alpha Values:**

* **We are mission-driven -** We’re changing the paradigm of healthcare for patients who are historically underrepresented due to sex, race, gender, language, economic status, location, disability, and other diverse backgrounds. We empower our Primary Care Providers with a foundation in women’s health to administer patient-centered care throughout a woman’s lifespan.
* **We put patients first -** We prioritize what’s best for our patients, not what’s easier or more profitable. We do whatever it takes to provide excellent care and empower patients to take control of their health.
* **One team, One Dream -** We work together as a team to bring to life our vision of a more just healthcare system. We trust each other, communicate openly and honestly. We give credit where it is due, provide opportunities for employee growth and development, assume good intentions, and celebrate our wins as a team.
* **Diversity is at our core -** Alpha exists to bring a more accessible, equitable system to care for the whole woman regardless of age, income, and location. We are inclusive, welcoming, and value different perspectives.
* **We are data-driven -** Alphanauts love data and value facts over opinions. We use evidence-based science to highlight the clinical value of our mission.
* **We are proactive and positive -** Alphanauts learn by doing and address challenges without waiting or worrying about their scope. We are pragmatic and value progress over perfection. We are optimistic and believe in the power of positivity.

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring a Clinical Product Operations Specialist to be the connective tissue between product, engineering, our care team and our partners. You will own three things end to end: the content that powers our patient-facing experience in Contentful, the data requests that keep the business informed in Amazon QuickSight, and the bug triage process that keeps our platform reliable. You will also write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) that make our work repeatable, act as the product expert for our clinical team, and help shape how we plan, ship and communicate releases.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Manage content in Contentful**

* Create, review and publish content entries, and keep a calendar of scheduled changes.
* Run a QA pass in our staging environment before anything patient-facing goes live.
* Keep content structure, naming and permissions consistent, and archive what is outdated.
* Write clear requests to engineering when a content type needs to change, and verify the result.

**Own data requests and reporting in QuickSight**

* Run a single intake process for data requests so every ask has an owner, a purpose and a deadline.
* Build and maintain QuickSight dashboards, and turn recurring requests into self-serve reports.
* Write SQL for ad hoc analysis and define key metrics so numbers match across reports.
* Check reports against underlying data before they go to partners, finance or leadership.
* Handle patient data responsibly by pulling only what each request needs.

**Run bug tracking and triage**

* Collect bug reports from our care team, support and partners, and link duplicates.
* Reproduce issues in staging and write up clear recaps with steps, expected and actual behavior, and screenshots.
* Lead a weekly bug review, verify fixes before closing, and update the person who reported each issue.

**Be the product expert for our clinical team**

* Know the patient dashboard and the care-team dashboard well enough to answer "how does this work?" from clinicians and clinical operations.
* Be the first point of contact for clinician questions and workflow issues; resolve what you can and escalate the rest.
* Be the owner of EMR (e.g., Athena) and resolve integration issues with EMR tech support
* Translate clinical workflow needs into clear, well-scoped requests for product and engineering.
* Walk clinicians through new features and changes, and bring their feedback back to the product team.
* Keep clinician-facing guides and training material accurate as the product changes.

**Keep product operations running**

* Coordinate releases: draft release clinical SOPs, write and maintain SOPs for recurring work across product, clinical and operations teams, such as content QA, data requests, bug triage and release checks.
* Support partner onboarding with checklists, test accounts and user acceptance testing.
* Send a regular update on content, data and bug queues, and keep the Jira backlog organized for clinical/operations requests

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 2-4 years in product operations, business operations, analytics or a similar role, ideally in health tech or healthcare.
* Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a BI tool such as QuickSight, Tableau or Looker.
* Experience managing content in a headless CMS, ideally Contentful.
* Experience managing EMR workflows, ideally Athena.
* Experience triaging and documenting bugs in Jira.
* Clear, concise writing: tickets, SOPs and updates that others can act on without a meeting.
* Ability to explain a technical product to non-technical clinical colleagues, and to turn their needs into clear requests for engineers.
* A careful, organized approach, and comfort working with sensitive health data under HIPAA.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Content modeling experience in Contentful.
* Experience writing SOPs or training material in a clinical or regulated environment.
* Familiarity with Amazon Redshift and dbt.
* Background in telemedicine, pha

new_jobs.title: Re-enrollment Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

**Our mission is simple but critical: to build pathways for adult learners to earn high-quality, workforce-aligned degrees and credentials from North Carolina’s public universities.**

**At Project Kitty Hawk, our work reflects our company values:**

**Collaboration** – We prioritize our partners’ success and reputation, aligning every initiative with their goals, reflecting their values, and enhancing their impact.

**Innovation** – We innovate, not replicate. As creative problem solvers, we use data-driven insights to push boundaries, continuously improve our services, develop solutions, and redefine what it means to serve nontraditional learners.

**Empathy** – We understand the unique challenges of nontraditional learners, and are committed to supporting them with empathy, respect, and solutions that fit their needs.

**Integrity** – We operate with transparency and accountability in everything we do. We uphold honesty, take ownership of our work, and maintain the highest standards.

**Teamwork** – We embody the collaboration we seek. We always strive to be dependable, supportive, and solutions-oriented teammates.

Together, we partner with universities in the University of North Carolina (UNC) System to produce innovative, flexible degree and credential programs in high-demand fields. Each PKH team member plays a vital role in advancing this mission and shaping the future of education for adult learners.

These values will enable us to realize PKH’s vision: to make North Carolina’s public universities the top choice for adult learners and to amplify the UNC System’s role as a national leader in higher education innovation, access, and student success. By joining our team, you have an opportunity to contribute to our achievement of that vision, in the process helping to create opportunities for thousands of learners to earn their success and move up the economic ladder.

At Project Kitty Hawk we hire talented people who are not only dedicated to our mission but share our belief that working together makes us stronger and more effective. In this organization you’ll find individuals with a range of interesting backgrounds and life stories; the true magic happens when those individuals come together to solve problems in service of a common goal.

### **The Role**

The Re-Enrollment Specialist (RES) is the primary point of contact for students who have stopped out before completing a degree and want to complete their degree at a UNC System institution. The RES leads the outreach to students, including calling contacts and prioritized segments, understanding the challenges students encountered before stopping out and what stands in the way of returning, and guiding them to the right readmission pathway at the appropriate UNC System institution.

### **What you'll do:**

* Execute high-volume outbound contact (call, text, email) to stopped-out students, prioritizing campaign responders and assigned segments in alignment with established cadences and content guidelines.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand each student’s reasons for stopping out, current goals, and barriers to return.
* Guide students through their next step, from selecting a pathway to starting the readmission or re-entry application, and confirm a warm handoff to the appropriate campus contact.
* Manage a personal pipeline in the CRM (Education Cloud), maintaining accurate dispositions, campus of origin and destination, and next actions.
* Monitor individual metrics, including contact rate, conversations, application starts, and campus handoffs, and take corrective action to improve results.
* Conduct long-term nurturing follow-up to student completers to gather information on student experience, success, and retention
* Develop and maintain working knowledge of the readmission policies, processes, and deadlines of each participating UNC System institution, including readmission versus new-application rules, time-away thresholds, academic standing and suspension requirements, holds, and transfer-credit considerations.
* Use the Re-Enrollment campus knowledge base to identify the correct pathway for each student’s situation and set accurate expectations about requirements and timelines.
* Apply System and campus operating rules on where a student may return (e.g., home-campus-first) and escalate exceptions or unclear cases to the REM.
* Capture structured, consistent data on stop-out reasons, barriers, and outcomes so the program can segment, prioritize, and report accurately.
* Share regular feedback with the REM on messaging performance, list and data quality, and recurring student objections to inform campaign and cadence adjustments.
* Flag policy changes, process friction, and discrepancies between published campus policy and student experience, and contribute updates to the knowledge base and team playbooks.
* Close the loop with campus partners on handoffs, confirming receipt and tracking returned outcomes to identify where students stall after reconnection.
* Partner with the REM and campus re-enrollment, registrar, and admissions contacts to resolve student questions and smooth the path back.
* Collaborate with PKH Marketing, Operations, and Analytics teams on campaign timing, list updates, and reporting.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all student records and CRM data in the RES’s personal pipeline.

### **What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 1+ years of experience in higher education admissions, advising, re-enrollment, or student recruitment, OR equivalent experience in high-volume outbound outreach or customer success.
* Preferred: Experience with readmission or registrar processes, adult and “some college, no credential” learners, or the UNC System.
* Comfort and consistency with high-volume outbound calling, including persistence and resilience with cold and re-engagement outreach.
* Ability to learn, compare, and accurately apply differing policies
